title: Data Quality Executive – Field Operations
description:
**Job Description**  

The purpose of this role is to ensure the integrity, reliability, and quality of data during live fieldwork by conducting continuous quality checks, proactive validations, and early issue detection. The role focuses on minimizing errors at the source through daily monitoring, Personal Back Checks (PBCs), and spot audits, thereby preventing data discrepancies and reducing downstream rework.


By identifying and addressing potential risks in real time, this position plays a critical role in maintaining adherence to research protocols, improving field execution standards, and safeguarding the overall credibility of study outcomes. Ultimately, the role contributes to delivering accurate, high\-quality insights and enhancing client trust.

**Responsibilities**

* Responsible for ensuring high standards of data quality during ongoing fieldwork by conducting continuous monitoring, proactive checks, and early issue identification to prevent data errors and maintain study integrity.
* Conduct daily quality checks across all active fieldwork projects to ensure adherence to study protocols and research methodologies.
* Monitor interviewer performance and response patterns.
* Identify inconsistencies, irregularities, or deviations from defined quality standards.
* Perform proactive Personal Back Checks (PBCs) during live fieldwork to validate 1\. Respondent authenticity 2\.Interview accuracy 3\.Data reliability and 4\. Target group authentication.
* Ensure that interviews are conducted as per guidelines and ethical standards
* Document findings and escalate discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Identify potential risks or recurring quality issues early in the fieldwork cycle.
* Take corrective actions such as 1\- Flagging suspicious interviews 2\- recommending rework OR respondent replacement.
* Work closely with project managers, and operations teams to implement preventive actions.
* Provide feedback and guidance to improve field execution quality.
* Support training initiatives based on recurring quality issues.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Market Research, Business, or related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in fieldwork quality control, data validation, or survey operations.
* Strong understanding of market research methodologies and field processes.
* Experience in conducting PBCs, spot checks, and quality audits.
* Ability to coach, influence, and hold interviewers accountable.
* Proficiency in Excel.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication skills for coordination with field teams and stakeholders.
* Computer literacy and accurate keyboard skills.
* Proficiency in local language(s) both written and verbal.
* Thorough understanding of the related NielsenIQ SOPs and field work standards.

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines

* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.

* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.

* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.

* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks

* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.

Responsible for day to day operational, financial, commercial \& administrative activities of the branch. Ensuring 100% compliance to regulatory and organizational guidelines.

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Job Context: Responsible for day to day operational, financial, commercial \& administrative activities of the branch. Ensuring 100% compliance to regulatory and organizational guidelines.  

  

Job Challenges: • Consistent delivery of 100% accuracy across wide range of activities amid rapidly changing processes, diverse organizational guidelines , adaptation to regular extended working hours, seasonal \& un predictable spike in volumes with limited or no system validations.  

  

* Maintaining confidentiality of information and documentation despite lack of infrastructure and support

* Handling Sales behaviour effectively in order to ensure compliance to internal and external guidelines
#### **Key Result Areas**

KRA1 Execute financial processes timely with 100% accuracy 1\. Execute the receipting, banking and reconciliation processes accurately for policy cash/Cheque/DD within timelines as per the set process.  

  

2\. Detection of Fake note to avoid operational loss  

  

3\. Cheque Dishonour Management.
  

  

4\. Safe custody of both sets of Safe and cash box Keys and one set of office keys.  

  

5\. Timely reconciliation of assets of the branch.  

  

6\. Ensure genuineness of petty cash spends, timely raising and recording.  


KRA10 Execute  

  

Advisor Licensing process \& extend Sales Support 1\. First time right application processing for New advisor and license renewal  

  

2\. Support BM on Recruitment plan is executed properly and the candidates are nominated for Pre Licensed training  

  

3\. Prepare \& distribute sales management MIS including data maintenance from Receipt Writer and Sales Portal to the concerned.  

  

4\. Coordinating for execution of reward \& recognition programs for sales force through MIS \& communications to branch sales force as required by the Branch Head.  

  

5\. Assist Branch Head to follow up for New Business Application requirements with the sales force of the branch  

  

6\. Control Pool laptops for agency managers  

  

7\. Managing sales promotion material \& activities at the branch level including stock management.  

  

8\. Inventory Management of marketing collateral  

  

9\. Assist HO in fraud and compliance investigation pertaining to FLS and advisors  

  

10\. Assist Branch Head to follow up for New Agent licensing requirements at new business and renewal stage with the sales force of the branch  

  

11\. Coordinate FLS coding and FLS tagging with HO  

  

12\. Coordinate for advisor / FLS Reward and Recognitions and for domestic \& overseas sales conference with HO  


KRA2 Execute  

  

Advisor Licensing process \& extend Sales Support 13\. Contact updation in BSLI online of Advisors and FLS  

  

14\. Contactability enhancement at NB stage,post welcome call followed by CRT.  

  

15\. Preparation of Various MIS related to BSLI Way and updation of Various Dash Boards.  

  

16\. Coordination with various institutes, approved by Training Head, for the training of new Insurance Applicant.  

  

17\. Re exam scheduling of failed candidates in coordination with BH/AMs  

  

18\. Coordination with RHR for offer letter generation for FLS  

  

19\. Arrangement of Various training programmes in Branches coordinating with Training manager and BM/BH.  

  

20\. Downloading various process to Sales team during morning huddle (BSLI Way).  

  

21\. Ensure timely opening and closing of office premises  


KRA3 Provide commercial support 1\. Identify local vendors and facilitate their registration as per procurement guidelines.  

  

2\. Procurement of vendor bills, establishing genuineness and timely payment as per agreement.  

  

3\. Encourage NEFT registrations of vendors.  

  

4\. Support lease agreement registration and renewal process.  

  

5\. New branch set up\- coordination with various functions like IT/Infra/banking/ZOPS/DSF for smooth functions of branch.  


KRA4 Extend Legal , Compliance and Taxation support 1\. Timely remittance of professional and work contract tax.
  

  

2\. Represent company on behalf of compliance/HO for hearing matters in labour/consumer court.  

  

3\. Timely updates to HO on receipt of any notice from Tax authorities/labour offices/employment exchange/Local municipal offices.  

  

4\. Ensure statutory displays at branches.  

  

5\. Ensure 100% compliance of AML guidelines, identification and reporting of suspicious \& fraudulent operational and financial transactions.  

  

6\. Adherence to BCP guidelines.  


KRA5 A\- Handle Advisor commission process  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

  

B\- Provide HR/IT/Admin support A\- 1\. Timely Updation \& handover of Commission chq to Advisors.  

  

2\. Encourage NEFT with advisors and FLS.  

  

3\. Resolve commission related queries of advisor.  

  

4\. Ensure timely receipts and hand\-over of TDS certificate to advisors.  

  

B\- 1\. Manage joining and exit formalities for concerned employees at the branch, including full and final settlement process.  

  

2\. Log calls in case of downtime/pursue with Corporate IT.
  

  

3\. Monitor and ensure housekeeping, security and dispatch services are rendered in an uninterrupted and cost effective manner.
  

  

4\. Handle physical resource booking like meeting rooms, projectors, etc.  


KRA6 Execute Underwriting and New Business processes 1\. Scrutinise New Business applications as per the SOPs to ensure 100% input accuracy to enhance straight through processing and issuance to submission ratio.  

  

2\. Arrange speedy pick up of medical reports from medical labs and timely transmission of applications, medical reports, requirements via scanning and indexing with 100% accuracy.
  

  

3\. Collaborate with head office process owners/vendors to facilitate faster issuance.  

  

4\. Ensure timely and accurate updation and delivery of policy documents/refund cheques in adherence to set standards.  


KRA7 Provide prompt, accurate and courteous Customer Service 1\. Ensure 1st contact resolution at the branch for all internal \& external customers’ \& track requests through prescribed systems ensuring 100% accuracy and timely closure.  

  

2\. Scrutinise claims documentation as per set guidelines and coordination with sales force and claimant for speedy fulfilment of claim requirements.
  

  

3\. Ensure 100% accurate and timely scrutiny \& processing of reinstatement, fund switch, financial payout requests \& other customer requests on the same day to avoid Gain/Loss. Customer identity \& signature to be verified to establish genuineness of the transaction.  

  

4\. Proactively participate in data cleansing exercise for both internal \& external customers in respect of Bank details, PAN card Information, contact details \& undelivered communications, .  


KRA8 Contribute to Revenue Generation \& conservation at every single opportunity \& instance. 1\. Encourage NEFT enrolment for internal \& external customers  

  

2\. Participating in Persistency drive by sharing data with sales force \& contacting customers for the allocated data base.  

  

3\. Encourage use of self help tools like Go Green, ECS activation, alternate payment options by customers.  

  

4\. Enhance contactability of the customers by collecting contact details.  

  

5\. Participate in cost savings initiatives.
  

  

6\. Actively endeavour towards containing Freelook/ Surrender / withdrawal at branches by convincing customers.  

  

7\. Actively engage with visiting customers to enhance revenue generation for the business by way of promoting Riders \& top up adding to incremental premium on the existing policies for the Co.  


KRA9 Contribute to Revenue Generation \& conservation at every single opportunity \& instance. 8\. Intimate \& pursue cheque dishonour cases with the respective sales team members / customer both at new business \& renewal stage \& strive for repayment to conserve the revenue.  

  

9\. Identify \& report fraudulent claims by providing proof / information to Claims team and get involved with the investigation as much required and sought.  

  

10\. Prevent Fraudulent / Fake Policies from issuance by Branches by controlling the document verification and reporting to Compliance \& UW  

  

11\. Save cost (on controllable expenses) at Branches on Electricity, Stationery, Photocopying, Staff Welfare, Other Miscellaneous Expenses etc

title: Lead, HR Quality and Compliance
description:
Lead, HR Quality and Compliance

**Location:** Hyderabad


This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 40% of your time (two days per week)

**Intro summary of the role**


This role is responsible for ensuring full statutory and regulatory compliance across HR, Payroll, and Talent Acquisition functions. The individual will proactively monitor legislative changes, implement necessary process updates, and partner with Legal, Finance, and HR Operations teams to manage compliance risk. The role also drives continuous improvement of payroll and TA processes while supporting audits, system enhancements, and key performance reporting. Strong stakeholder management and ownership of complex compliance issues are central to this position

**What you will get**

* An agile career and dynamic working culture.
* An inclusive and ethical workplace.
* Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
* A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.


The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

**What you will do**

* To ensure compliance with all statutory requirements, financial regulations or any other instructions in regard to HR, Payroll and Talent Acquisition (where applicable).
* Identify and implement changes to ensure that the Talent Acquisition and Payroll service is compliant, to current legislation, financial regulations, company policy and Labour Law and Agreements (CBA) as applicable to role
* Proactively monitor compliance changes in respective countries and provide compliance updates to HR Operations \& delivery teams, stakeholders and create/deliver communication plan to update impacted parties liaising with Lonza Legal team where required
* Whilst ensuring compliance and management of risk to always have the workforce experience at the heart of processes
* Ensure deadlines are met for statutory returns and payments where applicable.
* Continuous improvement of payroll related processes \& controls including business continuity plans, approaches to delivering a modern payroll function, simplification of legacy approaches.
* Continuous improvement of talent acquisition processes \& controls including business continuity plans, approaches to delivering a modern talent acquisition function, simplification of legacy approaches.
* Work closely with finance colleagues for monthly and period payroll\-related activities including reconciliations, maintenance of control accounts as applicable within HR, payroll and Talent Acquisition.
* Leading audits that impact HR Operations and Delivery with support from wider team
* Manage ad\-hoc projects.
* Take ownership of complex and technical issues and queries related to compliance and risk control.
* Advise the team and wider stakeholders on options and risks for a range of business decisions from a compliance and risk capacity perspective related to change.
* Cultivate relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* To gather, analyse and provide the relevant details in support of performance indicators and targets as and when required i.e. TA/WFA/payroll performance quality and accuracy
* To provide appropriate management information as and when required.
* To assist in the development and implementation of TA, HR \& Pay systems and their longer\-term development as required to support simplification of compliance and risk control.
* To ensure periodic statutory deductions from pay are properly reconciled and returns completed by the due date.
* Interacts and works closely with other HR Operations teams and the wider HR Community to deliver best in practice services to the Business and GPO.

**What we are looking for**

* 3\+ years of experience in HR, Payroll, or Talent Acquisition compliance, with a strong understanding of statutory requirements, financial regulations, and Labour Law/CBA.
* Proven experience identifying and implementing compliance changes in line with evolving legislation and company policy.
* Experience ensuring statutory returns, payments, and periodic deductions are reconciled and submitted within deadlines.
* Strong process improvement mindset, with experience supporting continuous improvement, business continuity planning, and system simplification initiatives.
* Experience supporting or leading audits, with the ability to take ownership of complex, technical compliance and risk\-related issues.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to advise teams and partners on compliance and risk implications, while maintaining a workforce\-first approach.

**About Lonza**


At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30\+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.


Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.


Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

description:
Job Description

*Job Title:*

**Duty Manager–FO**

*Reception/Guest Relations* 

è Check messages in the log and follow up when needed

è Check the status (occupancy, check\-ins check\-outs, stay overs and assign the room numbers accordingly)

è Check night shift duties are correctly done (checklist)

è Ensure that Housekeeping knows the status as well as about specific requests/arrival timings

è Check if all extras were posted as needed on the previous days the previous day

è Check and/or preparecurrent day’s check\-out bills

è *Check\-in* 

o *Call the guest when we have their contacts to learn their arrival time*

o *Identify when a car pulls up at the hotel door*

o *Call HK for luggage*

o *Ask for welcome drinks*

o *Assist the guests at reception (sit them down, asking about their journey, the purpose of visits … “small talk”)*

o *Take booking name to inform Housekeeping which room, take IDs for scanning and askto fill the GRC*

o *Show the map if the guest is interested (if not, keep it in the welcome letter and invite them to come at any time at the reception for any enquiry)*

o *Once everything is done \+ welcome drink done – take guest to the room. On the way, show the restaurant and ask if they would like a reservation*

o *Showthe room starting with keys, mini bar (what is complimentary and what is not), safe, massage card, AC remote, even mosquito repellent if needed. If the guests look tired, you just inform the minimum like key*

o *Give the Welcome Letter and wish them a nice stay*

è *Check\-out* 

o *Call HK to bring the luggage down and check mini bar/any valuables left in the room*

o *Ask about the guests stay and feedbacks*

o *Ask about mini bar consumption to match with HK and post accordingly*

o *Print the bill and explain it to the guest*

o *Takepayment*

o *Help the guest with luggage/taxi…*

o *“Goodbye” at the door if possible*

è Assist guest with any enquiry (taxi, massage, yoga, what to do during their stay, timings of main attractions, restaurant bookings …) and offer the best options

è Check with guests that their stay is going on well and take feedbacks in consideration for improvement

\- Follow up all requests and inform the team

o If it is an existing booking, it is noted in Hotelogix preference AND on the booking voucher

\- Make the bookings on Hotelogix for the TA or direct and fill the booking voucher

\- Print the OTAs vouchers and fill the booking vouchers

\- Send confirmation by EMAIL to every booking in order to have a written proof of all the details

\- Follow up payments \& refunds from guest/TA and receipts with Account department

o Remind TA of payment cutoff date and follow up when not received in time by phone and mail

o Check receipt of payment with the accounts department by email and phone and follow up with them when they do not respond

o Check the status of refunds with Financial Controller by email and phone

\- Link with OTA, website, PMS and CM when needed

o Booking.com – Extranet and POC

o Agoda – YCS and POC

o SimpleBooking

o Maximojo – closing rooms/edit tariffs

o Hotelogix – All admin console (as per current training)

\- Take responsibilities and decisions on

o Free upgrades, allowances or amenities offered

o Inform room guests about special events in our restaurants and share details

\- Cross check all emails sent when your Manager is not here and correcting any mistakes at the earliest in a polite manner

**JOB INTRODUCTION:**


A Career Guide supports individuals in making informed career choices by offering personalized advice on career paths, skill development, and job market trends. They assess clients' strengths and interests to recommend suitable career options and educational programs. Career Guides work with students, graduates, and professionals seeking career growth or change. Strong counseling and communication skills are key to helping clients achieve their career goals.Responsible for end to end student admission cycle.


**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Evaluates student recruitment techniques by determining the effectiveness of each recruitment technique.
  
* Welcomes prospective students by processing paperwork; interviewing applicants; conducting follow\-up activities such as emails and phone\-calling campaigns.
  
* Handling of student enquiries effectively.
  
* Explaining the candidate about the available IT courses and its payment plans and resolving their doubts and queries accordingly.
  
* Following up with the candidate for joining the course/ programme and for the payment.
  
* Making follow up calls for due payments from the candidates.
  
* Timely updation and scheduling of upcoming batches to all the concerned team members, trainers and students.
  
* Achieving targets set by the Branch Manager.
  
* Maintain a MIS of the students who have taken admissions or have done enquiries

* Excellent verbal and written communication to provide clear guidance and support.

* Attractive Incentive

* Medical Insurance along with the family covered
  
* OPD facility along with the family covered
  
* Chance to win Indian \& International trips
  
* Career Growth Enhancement
  
* Continuous training \& development

description:
**Job Title: Senior Specialist \[CL 8] – Event Management**  

**Location:** Delhi/ NCR  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, In Office on all days

**Department:** Accenture Workplace Services

**Reports to:** Workplace Event Management Manager \[CL 7]

 **Position Overview**:


The Event Planning \& Management, Senior Specialist is responsible for leading the strategy, planning, and execution of internal and client\-facing events that enhance workplace experience, strengthen brand presence, and support business objectives across our IT Services organization.


Operating within the Workplace \& Facilities function, this role ensures seamless delivery of events across corporate offices, innovation hubs, and hybrid environments. The Senior Specialist will drive operational excellence, governance, vendor partnerships, and continuous improvement across all event programs while aligning with corporate standards, compliance requirements, and cost optimization goals.


This role requires a strategic thinker with strong operational execution capabilities, cross\-functional leadership skills, and experience managing events within a corporate or technology\-driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership:**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive workplace events strategy aligned with corporate, HR, and business unit objectives.
* Establish scalable event frameworks and standards across regional offices and global locations.
* Define KPIs to measure event effectiveness, employee engagement impact, ROI, and cost efficiency.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance event quality, sustainability, and innovation.
* Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for workplace and corporate events within the organization.
* Identify emerging trends in corporate, hybrid, and technology\-enabled events.

**Event Management:**

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of internal and external events, including town halls, leadership summits, client engagements, workplace activations, and cultural initiatives.
* Oversee logistics including venue coordination, A/V, IT infrastructure setup, security, catering, branding, and facilities readiness.
* Manage onsite event operations and troubleshoot real\-time issues.
* Ensure compliance with health \& safety, security, and IT standards.
* Develop event timelines, run\-of\-show documentation, and contingency plans.
* Support hybrid and virtual event integration in collaboration with IT teams.

**Event Planning \& Optimization:**

* Standardize event intake, planning workflows, and resource allocation processes.
* Develop event playbooks, templates, and SOPs for consistency and scalability.
* Implement technology tools for event registration, tracking, and analytics.
* Optimize space utilization within corporate offices for events.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives through forecasting, budgeting, and vendor consolidation.
* Conduct post\-event analysis and apply lessons learned to future planning.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**

* Partner with HR, Marketing, Communications, IT, Security, and Business Leaders to align event objectives.
* Support executive leadership events with high\-touch coordination and confidentiality.
* Collaborate with Real Estate and Facilities teams to ensure venue readiness and compliance.
* Work closely with IT teams to support technical infrastructure needs (A/V, connectivity, digital signage).
* Align with Corporate Communications for branding and messaging consistency.
* Coordinate with Finance for budgeting, procurement, and expense management.

**Governance \& Reporting:**

* Establish governance frameworks for event approvals, budget controls, and compliance.
* Track and report on event performance metrics, cost savings, and operational KPIs.
* Ensure adherence to corporate procurement policies and risk management protocols.
* Maintain documentation and audit\-ready records for contracts, insurance, and compliance.
* Develop executive\-level dashboards and reporting summaries.
* Monitor sustainability and ESG considerations in event execution.

**Vendor and Asset Management:**

* Manage relationships with event vendors, venues, caterers, A/V providers, and logistics partners.
* Negotiate contracts and service\-level agreements (SLAs).
* Develop preferred vendor programs to improve service consistency and cost efficiency.
* Track and manage event\-related assets (furniture, technology, branding materials, digital equipment).
* Conduct vendor performance reviews and maintain scorecards.
* Oversee inventory management of event supplies and materials across locations.

 **Preferred Skills \& Certifications:**

* Certification such as CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) or CFM (Certified Facility Manager).
* Experience in global event coordination across multiple regions.
* Familiarity with ESG and sustainable event planning principles.
* Experience working in an IT Services or technology consulting organization.
* Knowledge of procurement and contract management systems.
* Experience supporting executive\-level events.

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic Thinking
* Operational Excellence
* Stakeholder Management
* Executive Presence
* Financial Acumen
* Risk Management
* Vendor Negotiation
* Project Management
* Communication \& Influence
* Problem Solving \& Agility
* Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Customer/Employee Experience Focus

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, Facilities Management, or related field.
* 12\-16\+ years of experience in corporate event planning within a technology or professional services environment.
* Experience supporting workplace, facilities, or corporate services functions.
* Strong budget management and vendor negotiation experience.
* Experience managing hybrid and virtual event environments.
* Knowledge of workplace operations and corporate real estate environments.
* Proficiency with event management software and Microsoft Office/Google Workspace.

title: Banking - Business Manager - Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Vice President – BEU Team Lead**


**Location:** Mumbai, India \| **Level:** Vice President \| **Type:** Full\-Time \| **Team:** Business Expense Unit (BEU)


**About the Role**


We're seeking a Vice President to join our Business Expense Unit team. Leads global business T\&E operations for banking professionals, ensuring policy compliance, cost optimization, and process efficiency. Develops and implements strategic expense management frameworks, drives cost\-reduction initiatives, and strengthens internal audit controls. Leverages data analytics and ServiceNow reporting to monitor performance, identify trends, and support informed budget planning and decision\-making.


**What You'll Do**


**Team Leadership**

* Lead and inspire a team, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability
* Define team goals, KPIs, and performance objectives aligned with business priorities
* Conduct regular performance reviews and support career development of team members
* Manage resource planning, workload distribution, and team capacity
* Champion diversity and inclusion initiatives within the team
* Provide guidance and support to local team members; handle senior\-level escalations

**Stakeholder \& Banker Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for senior Bankers, Sponsors, and Business Execution Leads (BELs)
* Lead performance reviews with preferred partners and contribute to global strategic initiatives
* Manage vendor partnerships and senior\-level business relationships
* Collaborate across Finance, Compliance, Procurement, and HR

**Strategic Leadership \& Governance**


* Provide strategic and visionary leadership for the T\&E program
* Champion value creation, operational efficiency, governance, and control
* Oversee performance analytics; ensure KPIs and SLAs are consistently met
* Deliver actionable insights and management reporting to optimize travel spend
* Lead process improvement and change management initiatives

**Expense Report Management:**


* Oversee the timely and compliant preparation and review of banker expense reports, ensuring strict adherence to Operating Expense Governance Policy (OEGP).
* Develop and implement robust controls to identify and flag non\-reimbursable expenses and policy violations.
* Effectively manage escalations, disputes, and exceptions to ensure efficient reimbursement processes and mitigate financial risk.

**Expense Pre\-Check \& Quality Assurance:**


* Lead and optimize the pre\-check process for all submitted expense reports, establishing it as a critical quality control layer.
* Drive continuous improvement in first\-time\-right submission rates through targeted training programs for EAs and BELs on OEGP policy and Concur submission best practices.
* Monitor and analyse pre\-check metrics to identify trends and implement corrective actions.

**Corporate Card Program Oversight:**


* Direct the end\-to\-end corporate card reconciliation process, including the generation of comprehensive spend summaries and analysis.
* Implement strategies to assist bankers in achieving timely card settlement, thereby reducing delinquency rates.
* Establish rigorous monitoring mechanisms for card usage, promptly identifying and addressing anomalous transactions, and fostering strong relationships with banking partners.

**Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) Operations (EMEA):**


* Manage and optimize the Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) cycle, overseeing both PO and non\-PO invoice processing specifically within the EMEA region.
* Serve as the primary Business Area Owner (BAO) for new vendor onboarding initiatives, ensuring compliance and efficiency.
* Establish proactive measures for timely invoice settlement, including the diligent management of aging reports and strategic escalation of overdue items.

**What You'll Bring**


**Required:**


* 10\+ years of experience in travel program management or expense management, with proven leadership in corporate travel roles
* Demonstrated success in leading teams, driving change, and championing diversity and inclusion
* Expertise in managing senior\-level business relationships and complex vendor partnerships
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft applications, SAP Concur, and leading travel management systems
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership capabilities
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and collaborate across time zones
* In\-depth knowledge of travel technology, policy development, and emerging industry trends
* Innovative and strategic thinker with a passion for continuous improvement

title: Hiring Manager
description:
A **hiring manager** is the department leader or supervisor who requests a new position, owns the talent pipeline for their specific team, and **holds the final authority to make the hiring decision**. Unlike full\-time HR professionals or internal recruiters who source candidates and manage corporate compliance, a hiring manager focuses on finding the right technical capability and cultural alignment to drive team productivity. \[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]The end\-to\-end roles and responsibilities of a hiring manager span five distinct phases of the talent acquisition lifecycle: \[1, 2]1\. Preparation and Role Definition

* **Identify Staffing Needs**: Assess current workloads to determine if a replacement or a brand\-new role is necessary to scale operations. \[1, 2]
* **Secure Requisition Approval**: Build the business case and negotiate salary budgets with senior executives or finance teams to get formal approval for the hire. \[1, 2]
* **Draft Job Descriptions**: Define required technical skills, daily responsibilities, mandatory qualifications, and key performance indicators (KPIs) in collaboration with HR. \[1, 2, 3]

2\. Recruitment Strategy and Sourcing

* **Align with the Recruiting Team**: Partner with internal recruiters to outline candidate profiles, establish realistic hiring timelines, and set up evaluation SLAs. \[1, 2]
* **Leverage Internal Networks**: Market the open position internally and proactively source talent via employee referral programs or professional industry networks. \[1, 2]
* **Refine Screening Filters**: Assist the talent acquisition team in optimizing applicant tracking system (ATS) filters and reviewing initial shortlists for highly specialized fields. \[1]

Pay: ₹180,000\.00 \- ₹200,000\.00 per year

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Description: HR Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Dadar, Mumbai, India
 



**Department:** 
 HR
 



**Reports To:** 
 Management
 



  





**About Rynox** 




 Rynox is a fast\-growing retail brand with an ambitious expansion roadmap. We are building out our HR function from the ground up and we need someone who can own it.
 



  





 This is not a coordinator role. You will be the HR function. You will work directly with the Founder, lead a small team, and be responsible for everything from getting the right people in the door to making sure they are paid correctly, treated well, and set up to do their best work.
 



  





 If you want a role where you manage a process someone else designed, this is not it. If you want to build something and have the authority to do so, read on.
 



  





**WHAT WILL YOU OWN** 




**Recruitment:** 




 •   Partner with department heads to understand hiring needs and build pipelines that move fast
 



 •   Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across HQ and stores, from sourcing to offer closure
 



 •   Oversee and guide your executive on CV sourcing, candidate calling, and initial screening; you will review pipelines, coach on quality, and step in where needed
 



 •   Given the nature of retail, replacement hires must be closed within the notice period so that store operations are not impacted
 



 •   Negotiate offers, manage candidate experience, and ensure every new joiner has a strong first day
 



  





**HR Operations and Payroll:** 




 •   Run monthly payroll end\-to\-end, including inputs, processing, disbursement, and resolution of employee queries
 



 •   Manage all statutory compliance including PF and ESIC filings, on time, every time
 



 •   Own the employee lifecycle: onboarding, confirmations, transfers, exits, and Full and Final settlements
 



 •   Ensure all employee records, documentation, and compliance are always audit\-ready
 



  





**Employee Relations:** 




 •   Be the go\-to person for employees across HQ and all store locations for any HR\-related query or concern
 



 •   Handle salary and deduction queries with clarity and empathy
 



 •   Address grievances fairly and quickly; flag patterns to leadership with solutions
 



  





**Policy \& Process:** 




 •   Identify gaps in HR policy and build frameworks where none exist, covering leave, attendance, expenses, and more
 



 •   Get policies approved, communicate them clearly, and ensure they are followed
 



 •   Continuously improve processes to reduce manual effort and improve the employee experience
 



  





**Culture \& Engagement:** 




 •   Own the induction experience so every new joiner understands what Rynox stands for
 



 •   Create a culture of accountability and warmth, structured enough to scale and human enough to matter
 



 •   Drive small but meaningful engagement moments across the team
 



  





**Who We're Looking For:** 




 You have 3 to 6 years of HR experience, ideally in a retail or consumer brand. You have run payroll, handled compliance, hired at volume, and resolved the kind of messy people situations that do not come with a textbook answer.
 



  





 More importantly, you have the mindset of an owner. You do not wait to be told. You see what needs to be done and you do it. You are equally comfortable sitting with the Founder to discuss a policy and speaking with a store manager to sort out an issue on the ground.
 



  





**You should apply if you are:** 




 •   Execution\-first: you close things, you do not just initiate them
 



 •   Comfortable with ambiguity: processes here are being built, not inherited
 



 •   Empathetic with employees and firm on compliance
 



 •   A strong communicator in English and Hindi; Marathi is a plus
 



 •   Someone who treats HR as a business function, not an administrative one
 



  





**Why Rynox** 




 •   Direct access to the Founder; your decisions matter and you will see their impact immediately
 



 •   Real ownership of the HR function, not a cog in a large HR machine
 



 •   A brand that is growing and investing in its people infrastructure
 



 •   Collaborative, no\-politics environment where good work is recognised

* Lead biyearly Workday upgrades, including end\-to\-end testing of Workday Recruit functionality.
* Partner with the Talent Acquisition CoE to analyze and enhance the candidate journey, using Workday Recruit configuration and supporting technologies to streamline application flow and improve candidate experience.

* History of significant customer satisfaction, building rapport, and influencing decisions while working in a consultative role with customers.

We’d ideally love you to have experience as a contributing team member within HR operational projects and new implementations, including the full change request lifecycle (solution design, configuration, testing, communication, etc.). An overall understanding of HR data, HR processes, and the change/implementation life cycle is important.

* Workday Recruit (job requisitions, job postings, candidate stages, screening steps, offer workflows, and recruiting related security)
* Payroll

description:
**Job Description**
 The Company
   

  

 Serving the People Who Serve the People
   

  

 Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.
   

  

 Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud\-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.
   

  

 Want to know more? See more of what we do here .
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Business Systems Analyst I is a developing contributor who supports the implementation and enhancement of digital services for government clients. This role focuses on gathering and documenting business requirements, assisting with process analysis, and contributing to the delivery of solutions that meet defined client and project needs.
   

  

 The analyst collaborates with technical and non?technical stakeholders, applying strong communication and analytical skills to help translate business needs into system requirements. They work under guidance from senior analysts or project leaders, managing assigned tasks with increasing independence while building domain knowledge and technical understanding.
   

  

 The Business Systems Analyst I contributes to team success by supporting project documentation, participating in solution design discussions, and helping maintain project momentum. Success in this role requires a willingness to learn, attention to detail, adaptability, and a commitment to delivering high?quality work while developing professional and technical skills.
   

  

 What Your Impact Will Look Like
   

  

* Work with clients to gather system requirements and produce detailed requirements and functional specification documents to solve moderately complex problems within information systems.
* Analyze business and user needs, document requirements, and revise existing system logic difficulties as necessary.
* Validate, analysed and import initial and final data as approved by the customer.
* Work closely with the development team to ensure requirements are fully understood and provide assistance with overcoming obstacles faced during development.
* Conduct system testing at the development site and at the client site to validate requirements.
* Train end users and provide user support while ensuring the use of up\-to\-date user manuals during the operation phase or as requested by the supervisor.
* Consult with management to ensure agreement on system principles.
* Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for user acceptance and ensure quality standards.
* Expand or modify systems to serve new purposes or improve current operations.
* Define the goals of the system and devise flow charts and diagrams describing the logical operational steps of programs.
* Serve as project leaders for particular systems projects.
* Document the experience in current projects to find new metrics, techniques, and strategies to improve targeting, measurements, and projects success in the future.
* Document reports design and specifications for custom reports development or modification.
* Provide support to the development team during development and testing.
* Contribute to project documentation by updating project binders and project sites as stated.
* Complete project tasks within establish deadlines and communicate delivery status to project team and management on a timely basis.
* Participation in the sales cycle will also be required. Consultants should be able to function equally as well independently or as part of a larger implementation team.
* Work with the product development team to identify potential product enhancements.
* Communicate with customers, competitors, suppliers, professional organizations, or others to stay abreast of industry or business trends.
* Communicate effectively with business representatives at all levels of the organization.
* Perform other tasks related to project or customer activities, as assigned by Supervisor.


 You Will Love This Job If You Have
   

  

* Excellent understanding or ERP fundamental software and tools.
* Knowledge of common best practice financial, accounting and business practices.
* Possess knowledge of governmental or local regulations that affect.
* Strong knowledge of systems’ implementation and testing methodology, best practices, and project phases.
* Ability to easily adapt to fast\-paced environment.
* Flexible during times of change, and deadline proximities.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills both in Spanish and English.
* Proficient using Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Power Point, Project, and Access).
* Must be oriented to detail, teamwork and customer service.
* Strong organizational, communication, and presentation skills.
* High sense of professionalism.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Ability to communicate and work fluently with business users, technical people and management across the organization.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Proficient using Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Power Point, and Outlook).
* Advance knowledge of Excel data management functionalities (e.g. macros, pivots), and financial reporting tools such as FRX and Management Reporter.
* Demonstrate an expert understanding of a variety of software modules including (but not limited to) General Ledger, Sales Order Processing and Accounts Receivables.
* Management, Purchasing and Payables Management, Human Resources, Payroll, Fixed.
* Assets and Bank Reconciliation. Knowledge of General Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), Not\-for\-Profit and Governmental Accounting Standard Board (GASB) principles.
* Basic understanding of multi\-currency concepts.
* Basic knowledge of SQL, database and infrastructure concepts for ERP deployment.
* Understanding of Quality Assurance and Testing Principles
* This is a hybrid position, requiring a blend of remote and in\-office work. Additionally, the role includes on\-site visits to customers as needed, so candidates should be comfortable with traveling to all PR municipalities.


**About Us**
 Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!
   

  

 Security And Privacy Requirements
   

  

* Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
* Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.


 The Team
   

  

* We are a remote\-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.


 The Culture
   

  

* At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to be a part of our journey.

* Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important and sometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work\-life balance and current affairs.

 The Impact
   

  

* We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here .


 The Benefits
   

  

 At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.

* Pension Plan and Retirement options

* Online Learning Platforms – Fuel your professional development.
* Competitive Salary \& Bonuses – Your contributions are valued and rewarded.


 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 Granicus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.
   

  

**Company Description**
 At Granicus, our mission is to help better engage government and the people they serve. Join our team and be a part of something exceptional. With more than 2,000 employees across the globe supporting more than 7,000 public sector organizations, Granicus is a trusted partner for governments to make meaningful connections.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
**About the Role \-**  

We’re a fast\-growing technology company building AI\-powered automations to run leaner and ship faster. We’re looking for sharp, self\-driven freshers and interns who genuinely enjoy building with AI — people who would rather create a workflow that handles a task 100 times than do it manually once. This is a pure automation and tooling role. You will work directly with the founder and teams to find repetitive processes and turn them into reliable, AI\-assisted pipelines. Your job is to build the automations — not to work in any specialist domain. You will start building and shipping real automation from week one.  

  

**What You’ll Do** • Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n, Make.com, or Zapier to connect internal systems (CRM, email, ticketing, reporting). • Use LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI) and strong prompt engineering to automate report drafting, data extraction, summarization, and research workflows. • Build internal AI tools — RAG\-based knowledge assistants, document generators, and simple dashboards that teams actually use every day. • Identify manual, repetitive processes across the company and turn them into reliable automated pipelines. • Work with structured and unstructured data (PDFs, spreadsheets, logs) to clean, parse, and feed it into automated workflows. • Test, document, and iterate on everything you build so others can trust and reuse it.  

  

  

**Tools You’ll Work With** \-You’ll get hands\-on experience with a modern automation stack: • LLM APIs: OpenAI, Claude • Automation Platforms: n8n, Make.com, Zapier • Languages \& Frameworks: Python, LangChain, CrewAI • Data \& Integrations: REST APIs, Webhooks, Vector Databases • Tools: GitHub, Google Workspace, Notion What We’re Looking For • Genuine interest in AI and automation — you’ve already experimented with ChatGPT/Claude, n8n/Make/Zapier, or similar tools on your own. • Basic coding ability (Python preferred) — enough to write scripts, call APIs, and debug simple issues. • Logical, structured thinking — you can break a messy manual process into clear, automatable steps. • Strong ownership \& curiosity — you figure things out, ask good questions, and take initiative without waiting to be told what to do. • Good written English for documentation and prompt writing

title: Security Analyst L1
description:
**Job Description: Security Analyst L1**   
**Location:** Delhi (Onsite) **Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience Level:** Entry Level / Fresher  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Only  
**Company Name:** Marven Data Systems Pvt Ltd

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a sharp, articulate, and proactive **Security Analyst** to join our offensive security team in Delhi. In this role, you will be deployed onsite at client location.

As the on\-ground representative of our security team, you must combine technical curiosity in ethical hacking with **exceptional communication skills** to seamlessly collaborate with client IT teams and explain security findings clearly.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Assessment Execution:** Run scoped vulnerability assessments across client networks, web applications, and endpoints under the guidance of senior consultants.
* **Client Interface s Communication:** Act as the primary on\-site point of contact.
* Explain the deployment process, outline project prerequisites, and manage client expectations professionally.
* **Triage s Troubleshooting:** Identify and resolve technical roadblocks during the exercise while keeping the client transparently updated.
* **Reporting s Debriefing:** Assist in compiling clear, structured VAPT reports. Deliver basic verbal walkthroughs of identified vulnerabilities and proof\-of\-concepts to client technical teams.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**

· **Communication Skills (Critical):**

* Flawless verbal and written English and Hindi communication skills.
* The ability to confidently explain technical risks to client IT managers without sounding confrontational.
* Strong technical writing skills for drafting vulnerability executive summaries.

**· Advantage having Technical Knowledge:**

* Solid understanding of the **OWASP Top 10** (for web apps) and infrastructure security concepts.
* Familiarity with common VAPT tools (Kali Linux, Metasploit, Nmap, Burp Suite, Nessus).
* Good understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, SSH) and how to navigate Linux/Windows command lines.
* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc in Cyber Security, Computer Science, IT, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred (Bonus) Qualifications**

* Practical experience from Bug Bounty programs, Hack The Box, or TryHackMe.
* Relevant certifications: Certified Ethical Hacker (**CEH**), CompTIA **PenTest\+**, or **eJPT**.
* Prior experience in public speaking, technical presentations, or client\-facing college leadership roles.

**Key Job Details \& Benefits**

* **Immediate Availability:** Candidates must be available to join within 0–7 days.
* **Onsite Presence:** 100% onsite role requiring daily travel to corporate client sites across Delhi NCR.

Pay: ₹250,000\.00 \- ₹450,000\.00 per year

Work Location: On the road

Our entire production pipeline runs **in\-house**, allowing us to handle **high\-volume bulk projects with some of the fastest turnaround times in the industry**. With a network of **500\+ voice artists**, **25,000\+ projects delivered**, and **TPN content security certification**, Sukudo Studios is trusted by content producers globally to bring their stories to every audience, in every language.

**Job Overview**

Sukudo Studios is looking for a **Recording Engineer / Dubbing Engineer** to join our growing studio team. We are seeking someone who is **technically strong, detail\-oriented, and passionate about audio production**, with **0–4 years of experience** in recording, dubbing, voice\-over, or studio operations.

This role is ideal for candidates who have a solid understanding of **audio fundamentals, recording workflows, dubbing sessions, studio equipment, and artist coordination**. Freshers with strong practical training and a genuine interest in studio recording are also encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Record and manage **dubbing, voice\-over, and voice recording sessions** with artists
* Set up and operate **microphones, preamps, headphones, audio interfaces, and studio recording equipment**
* Conduct **sound checks** and ensure recordings are clean, balanced, and free from noise or technical issues
* Guide, cue, and communicate effectively with **voice artists** during sessions
* Maintain proper **recording levels, gain staging, and overall session quality**
* Perform **basic editing tasks** such as:
* Breath removal
* Cleaning takes
* Comping
* Cutting and organizing recordings
* Organize **session files, folder structures, naming conventions, and backups** systematically
* Identify and troubleshoot recording issues such as **clipping, plosives, sibilance, distortion, and background noise**
* Ensure all **studio equipment is maintained and functioning properly**
* Coordinate with internal teams and support **mixing engineers / technical team members** as needed
* Work efficiently in a **high\-volume production environment** while maintaining quality standards and turnaround timelines

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of **audio engineering and recording fundamentals**
* Knowledge of:
* **Gain staging**
* **Microphone placement**
* **Signal flow**
* **Monitoring levels**
* **Room acoustics basics**
* Hands\-on experience with at least one **DAW** such as:
* **Pro Tools**
* **Logic Pro**
* **Cubase**
* **Ableton Live**
* or similar
* Understanding of **sample rate, bit depth, recording formats, and session setup**
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of:
* **EQ**
* **Compression**
* **Noise reduction / cleanup**
* Ability to identify and manage issues like:
* Clipping
* Plosives
* Sibilance
* Unwanted noise
* Distortion
* Comfortable handling **condenser microphones, preamps, headphones, and studio hardware**
* Good communication skills and confidence in working directly with **voice artists and studio teams**
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to work under deadlines

**Eligibility / Qualifications**

* **0–4 years of experience** as a **Recording Engineer, Dubbing Engineer, Audio Engineer**, or in a similar studio role
* **Freshers with strong practical knowledge of recording and dubbing workflows may also apply**
* Diploma, degree, or certification in **Audio Engineering, Sound Technology, Music Production, or a related field** is preferred

**Who Should Apply**

This role is a good fit for someone who:

* Wants hands\-on experience in a **fast\-paced dubbing and localization studio**
* Has a strong interest in **voice recording, dubbing, and post\-production workflows**
* Can balance **technical precision** with **artist handling and studio coordination**
* Enjoys working on **high\-volume content projects** across multiple languages and formats

**Why Join Sukudo Studios**

* Work with a **TPN\-certified studio** trusted by global content producers
* Be part of a team handling **OTT, films, web series, short dramas, and creator content**
* Gain exposure to **large\-scale multilingual dubbing and localization workflows**
* Collaborate with a network of **500\+ voice artists**
* Learn and grow in a **high\-output, high\-learning studio environment**

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume or mail us at: hr@sukudostudios.com

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Are you the person who is always planning the next trip, discovering new artists, tracking upcoming festivals and experiences, and convincing friends to join you on the adventure?


Do you dream of building a career at the intersection of travel, music, culture, community, and live experiences?


We’re looking for someone who is passionate about experiences and excited to help build unique journeys, community\-led experiences, festival trips, special projects, and new ideas from the ground up.


You’ll work across a diverse range of projects spanning travel, hospitality, music, festivals, community, culture, entertainment, and new experience\-led initiatives across the Zo ecosystem.


This is not a traditional desk job.


One week, you might be researching a destination, identifying an emerging festival, helping build an itinerary, brainstorming a new experience, or supporting a marketing campaign. The next week, you could be coordinating with partners, assisting with on\-ground execution, or helping bring an experience to life.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Experience Development \& Research**

* Assist in building itineraries, concepts, and experience formats.

### **Project Planning \& Execution**

* Support the planning and execution of trips, experiences, and community projects.
* Coordinate with partners, vendors, creators, and stakeholders.
* Assist with on\-ground execution whenever required.
* Help ensure projects run smoothly from concept to launch.

### **Community \& Growth**

* Support community\-building and engagement initiatives.
* Assist with content ideas, activations, campaigns, and audience engagement.
* Work closely with marketing, content, partnerships, and operations teams.

### **Special Projects**

* Work on new ideas, collaborations, experiments, and experience concepts.
* Support projects across travel, music, festivals, entertainment, community, and live experiences.

**Who We’re Looking For**
-------------------------

* Freshers and early\-career professionals (0\-2 years) are encouraged to apply.
* Passionate about travel, music, festivals, concerts, culture, communities, and live experiences.
* Curious about how experiences are built behind the scenes.
* Creative, proactive, and willing to take ownership.
* Comfortable wearing multiple hats and learning on the go.
* Strong communication and people skills.
* Open to travel whenever projects require it.

**Bonus Points If**
-------------------

* You’ve travelled specifically for a concert, festival, or unique experience.
* You regularly attend concerts, festivals, gigs, community events, or cultural experiences.
* You are a musician, creator, traveler, photographer, storyteller, or community enthusiast.
* You naturally keep track of what’s happening across music, travel, culture, entertainment, creators, and emerging trends.
* You have worked on personal projects, side hustles, communities, content, events, or anything you’ve built out of pure passion.

**You Don’t Need Experience. You Need Passion.**
------------------------------------------------


We’re happy to consider freshers and early\-career professionals.


What matters most is curiosity, ownership, willingness to learn, and a genuine interest in travel, music, culture, festivals, community, and live experiences.


If you’ve ever planned a trip around a concert, followed festival lineups for months, discovered artists before they became popular, or spent hours researching your next adventure, you’re already closer to this role than you think.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* Work on unique trips, festivals, community experiences, and special projects.
* Help create experiences that bring people together.
* Travel to unique destinations and work on projects from idea to execution.
* Collaborate with creators, artists, partners, brands, and communities.
* Be part of building the future of experiential travel and community\-led experiences.

### **This Role Might Be Perfect For You If…**


You’ve ever travelled for a concert, planned an entire trip around a festival, spent hours discovering new artists, dreamed of working in the music or live experiences industry, or wondered how memorable experiences are created behind the scenes.


This is a dream opportunity for people who are genuinely passionate about travel, music, culture, community, festivals, concerts, and the business of creating unforgettable experiences.

**Summary**
-----------


We’re looking for a Zo Trips Experiences Associate to build and scale unique travel, festival, and community\-led experiences. Work across travel, music, culture, and live events—bringing ideas to life from concept to execution. Join Zo Trips by Zostel. Live It. Now.

title: Clinical Operations & Support Executive
description:
**Company**
===========


**JD For Clinical Operations \& Support Executive**
---------------------------------------------------


### **About Us**


Company is a digital healthcare company established in partnership with Isansys UK (www.isansys.com). We offer one of the most complete, scalable, and user\-friendly advanced patient monitoring platforms for hospitals. Our business focuses on delivering patient\-centered technologies and data\-driven methods into hospitals and healthcare organizations, providing health professionals with vital tools to improve care, increase clinical performance, ensure economic value, and enhance patient safety.


The company is promoted by two senior executives from the healthcare and IT fields with over 50 years of collective experience across IT functions and business leadership. Both are alumni of the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore. After working with reputed Indian \& American organizations, they have joined forces to establish this organization, aiming to bring technological advancements in monitoring that will become a rhythm of life.


### **Our Product/Solution**


Our solution is a wireless remote patient monitoring system with built\-in predictive analytics and an early health warning system. It comprises the following components:


* **Patient wearable sensors/devices:** Advanced wireless devices that capture patient vitals and transmit them via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to a nearby tablet.
* **Gateway:** A Samsung Android tablet that consolidates data from all sensors/devices for a patient and sends it to a back\-end server via Wi\-Fi.
* **Back\-end application:** A Windows Server (2012/2016 R2 server) based application that receives patient data from multiple gateways across wards and hospitals. It operates on an SQL or MySQL database.

The overall system is FDA and CE Class II approved and adheres to the latest security and healthcare industry standards like HL7/FHIR, etc.


### **Skills \& Experience Needed**


We are seeking a candidate with a nursing, science, or biology background for the implementation and demonstration of our remote patient monitoring solution across various hospital care areas. The expected skills include:


* Understanding of patient care aspects / Flair for patient care
* Basic understanding of the hospital working environment
* Ability to work closely with clinicians and nursing staff in hospitals
* Basic Microsoft Word and Excel skills

Smart freshers or individuals with one year of experience in any of the above areas, or any experience managing hospital, clinic, or lab operations, would be preferred. In the absence of this experience, candidates with a willingness to learn, energy to acquire new skills, and a passion for patient care can also be considered.


**Educational Qualifications:** Diploma in Nursing, BSc/MSc in Science or any other healthcare stream, B.Tech/BE Biomedical.


### **Responsibilities**


We will provide comprehensive training on the clinical aspects of our solution. Upon completion of training, the candidate will be expected to fulfill the following role:


* Demonstrate our state\-of\-the\-art solution in hospital clinical environments.
* Train hospital staff on the effective utilization of our product/solution.
* Manage operations related to our product for successful rollout and post\-rollout support at hospital(s). This includes assisting nurses in initiating patient monitoring, troubleshooting issues during monitoring, and maintaining sensors and devices.
* Document key operational aspects and learnings derived from them.
**Important:** Note that this is not a remote job. The selected candidate will be required to work full\-time in one or more hospitals to perform the above activities.

Jharsuguda, Odisha \| Full\-Time \| ₹10,500 – ₹13,000/month

\-\-\-

\*\*About Us\*\*

Narayani Decor \& Furnishing is one of Jharsuguda's established home decor and furnishing showrooms, offering a wide range of curtains, sofa covers, cushions, furniture, and household products. We are a growing business with a close\-knit team and a strong local customer base. As we expand operations, we are looking for a reliable and organised Store Manager to take charge of the showroom's day\-to\-day running.

\-\-\-

\*\*Role Summary\*\*

This is a senior floor\-level role that sits at the heart of our showroom operations. You will be responsible for billing, cash management, stock tracking, staff coordination, and ensuring the showroom runs smoothly every single day — even when the owner is not present. This is the most trusted role in the store, and we are looking for someone dependable, organised, and confident enough to own it fully.

\-\-\-

\*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*

* Handle all daily billing — generate bills, collect payments (cash/UPI/card), issue receipts to customers
* Manage the petty cash box and submit a daily cash reconciliation report to the owner via WhatsApp
* Open and close the showroom every day using a defined checklist (display setup, staff attendance, cash secured)
* Track stock levels — identify low\-stock items and inform the owner for reordering
* Coordinate and assign daily duties to all floor staff; monitor lunch schedules and team activities
* Handle customer complaints or escalations that floor staff cannot resolve
* Approve small discounts within authorised limits; escalate larger decisions to the owner
* Maintain the staff attendance register — daily in and out times for all team members
* Receive incoming deliveries and verify item counts against the purchase challan
* Coordinate with vendors and delivery parties for timing and logistics
* Send a concise daily sales and operations summary to the owner via WhatsApp at end of shift
* Guide and support new joiners during their first 2 days of onboarding

\-\-\-

\*\*Requirements\*\*

* Minimum 12th Pass — Graduate (B.Com / BA) preferred
* Must be able to read, write, and calculate in Hindi or Odia
* Comfortable operating billing software on a phone or computer (training provided if needed)
* Basic arithmetic skills — adding bills, calculating discounts, giving correct change
* Good communication skills — able to speak clearly with both customers and staff
* Honest and trustworthy — this role handles daily cash and has full access to store operations
* Age: 18 to 35 years preferred
* Gender: Open — male or female
* Prior experience in retail billing, shop management, or any counter/admin role is preferred but not mandatory — freshers with the right qualifications will be considered

\-\-\-

\*\*What We Offer\*\*

* Basic Salary: ₹10,500/month
* Attendance Allowance: ₹1,500/month (paid when attendance is 26\+ working days)
* Performance Bonus: ₹1,000/month (based on billing targets and smooth operations)
* Total monthly earnings: ₹12,000 regular / up to ₹13,000 with full bonus
* Retention Bonus: ₹500 at 3 months, ₹1,000 at 6 months, ₹2,000 at 1 year of service
* Annual Increment: 10–15% on basic salary after 1 year
* Stable, full\-time position with a well\-known local business
* Supportive work environment with a small, friendly team

\-\-\-

\*\*How to Apply\*\*

Interested candidates can send their name, educational qualification, and a brief note about any relevant experience to us via WhatsApp or walk into our showroom directly.
