title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
About the Role
 



 We're looking for a Senior HR Manager who has lived inside a high\-volume retail or QSR environment and knows what it takes to keep dozens of stores fully staffed, well\-trained and motivated. This is a hands\-on, build\-and\-scale role, not a maintenance one. You'll own the full people lifecycle for our frontline and store\-management teams across three cities, and you'll be the person who makes sure our headcount keeps pace with our store rollout without sacrificing quality of hire.
 



 You'll partner directly with the MD, cluster managers and the training function, and you'll bring the systems, discipline and energy needed to run HR at scale across a distributed network.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Own high\-volume recruitment for store crew, shift leads and store managers across all three cities, building a pipeline that stays ahead of the store\-opening calendar.
* Build and maintain a sourcing engine (referrals, hyperlocal channels, institutes, gig platforms) that fills frontline roles fast and at the right cost\-per\-hire.
* Forecast manpower needs against the expansion plan and new\-store launch timelines.



**Retention \& Engagement** 



* Tackle frontline attrition head\-on — diagnose root causes, design interventions, and bring measurable improvement to retention and tenure.
* Run engagement, recognition and feedback mechanisms suited to a young, distributed, shift\-based workforce.



**Performance, Training \& Development** 



* Partner with the Head of Training to ensure every new hire moves through structured onboarding and sign\-off gates before going live on the floor.
* Drive a clear performance\-management rhythm across stores, including goal\-setting, reviews and career pathing for high performers.



**HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Own statutory and labour\-law compliance across all locations — Shops \& Establishments, PF, ESI, minimum wages, contract labour and store\-level documentation.
* Standardise HR processes, policies, SOPs and the HRIS so the system scales cleanly as store count grows.
* Manage payroll inputs, attendance discipline, grievance handling and disciplinary processes fairly and consistently.



**Franchise \& Multi\-City Support** 



* Define people standards, hiring frameworks and training expectations that franchise partners adopt to keep service quality consistent network\-wide.
* Act as the central HR point of contact for cluster managers in Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad.



 What We're Looking For
 


* 8\+ years in HR, with at least 4 in a senior role within QSR, food \& beverage retail, organised retail or a multi\-outlet chain.
* Proven track record managing high\-volume frontline recruitment and reducing attrition in a shift\-based workforce.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour law and multi\-state statutory compliance.
* Experience standing up HR systems and processes in a scaling business — not just running an established one.
* Comfortable operating across multiple cities and stores, with willingness to travel.
* Hands\-on, founder\-mindset operator who can both set strategy and get into the detail.
* Fluency in English and Tamil; conversational Kannada and/or Telugu is a strong plus.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent preferred.

title: People Operations
description:
We Are:
   

  

 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
   

  

 You Are:
   

  

 You are an accomplished People Operations professional with a passion for transforming HR processes and enhancing employee experience at every stage of the lifecycle. Your expertise spans the full spectrum of HR, from Talent Acquisition and Onboarding to Performance Management, Total Rewards, Employee Relations, HR Operations, and Offboarding. You thrive in dynamic environments and excel at evaluating current\-state operations, identifying opportunities for improvement, and architecting scalable, future\-proof solutions that balance efficiency, compliance, and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
* Support large\-scale HR transformation initiatives such as shared services implementation, digital transformation, or post\-merger integration.
* Lead the end\-to\-end design, optimization, and documentation of HR processes across Talent Acquisition, Onboarding, Performance Management, Total Rewards, Employee Relations, HR Operations, and Offboarding.
* Conduct comprehensive assessments of existing HR operations, identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process harmonization and standardization.
* Develop structured process maps, workflow documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), job aids, templates, and toolkits to enable scalable, enterprise\-wide HR practices.
* Facilitate structured process discovery activities, including stakeholder interviews, cross\-functional workshops, and workflow analysis sessions to capture operational realities.
* Lead and manage cross\-functional HR transformation projects, including defining scope, setting milestones, managing project risks, and ensuring on\-time delivery of key initiatives.
* Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, Shared Services, and HRIS teams to align process design with technology enablement and service delivery models.


 The Impact You Will Have:
   

  

* Elevate the efficiency and effectiveness of HR operations, contributing directly to Synopsys’ ability to attract, engage, and retain top talent.
* Enhance employee experience by streamlining and standardizing critical HR processes across the organization.
* Drive process harmonization and reduce operational variability, enabling scalable growth and business agility.
* Enable data\-driven decision\-making through clear, structured process documentation and improved process visibility.
* Support compliance and risk mitigation by ensuring HR processes adhere to regulatory and organizational standards.
* Empower business leaders and HR stakeholders with tools and resources to effectively manage people practices in a rapidly evolving environment.


 What You’ll Need:
   

  

* Extensive experience of 8\-10 years leading HR process design, transformation, and optimization initiatives across the full employee lifecycle.
* Bachelor’s/ Masters’s degree in Human Resource or equivalent.
* Proven ability to evaluate current\-state HR operations and architect scalable, future\-state processes that drive efficiency and compliance.
* Deep expertise in developing enterprise\-grade HR documentation, including process maps, SOPs, job aids, and toolkits.
* Demonstrated ability to drive process harmonization across multiple business units, regions, or legacy operating models.
* Experience supporting large\-scale HR transformation initiatives such as shared services, operating model redesign, or digital transformation.
* Advanced analytical, written, and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex workflows into clear, actionable documentation.


 Who You Are:
   

  

* A collaborative team player who thrives in matrixed and evolving environments.
* An effective communicator who can influence and build alignment with senior stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented, analytical, and highly organized, with a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
* Adaptable and resilient, able to navigate ambiguity and drive change in fast\-paced settings.
* Empathetic, with a strong customer\-service orientation and a passion for enhancing the employee experience.
* Curious, proactive, and eager to stay at the forefront of HR innovation and best practices.


 The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
   

  

 You’ll join a high\-impact, forward\-thinking People Operations team dedicated to driving HR excellence and transformation at Synopsys. The team collaborates closely with HR Centers of Excellence, Business Partners, Shared Services, and HRIS to deliver integrated, technology\-enabled solutions that support the company’s growth and strategic objectives. You’ll be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to continuous improvement and to making Synopsys a great place to work for all.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits:
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

All educational programs initiated by Bharti Airtel Foundation entail close partnerships with the government, policy makers, corporations, local communities and the general public. These programs aim at holistic development of children making them employable citizens with a deep sense of commitment to society.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**HRMS Transformation \& System Management**
* Implementation \& Maintenance: Manage end\-to\-end implementation and rollout of HR digital platforms, especially HRMS modules (Performance, Leave, Recruitment, Learning, etc.).
* Process Automation: Coordinate with product vendors for system configuration, pilot testing, and deployment. Conduct system testing (UAT), flag bugs, track resolution timelines, and ensure smooth handover.
* User Training \& Support: Provide training and ongoing support to HR staff and employees on HRMS functionalities, enhancing user adoption and system utilization.
* System Enhancements: Collaborate with IT and HR teams to implement system upgrades and integrate new modules that align with evolving organizational needs.


**HR Analytics \& Reporting**
* Data Analysis: Utilize HRMS data to analyze key metrics such as employee turnover, engagement, and performance, providing insights to inform HR strategies.
* Dashboard Development: Design and maintain interactive dashboards and reports that visualize HR data, aiding leadership in data\-driven decision\-making.
* Predictive Analytics: Apply predictive modeling techniques to forecast HR trends, such as attrition rates and hiring needs, enabling proactive workforce planning.
* Compliance \& Data Security: Ensure HR data complies with relevant regulations and implement measures to protect sensitive employee information.


**Process Improvement \& Digital Transformation**
* Identify repetitive HR processes and lead their digitization through tools and low\-code platforms.
* Work with HR teams to document workflows and design automation scripts or configurations.
* Monitor the performance of automated processes, troubleshoot issues, and improve process reliability.
* Continuously scan for opportunities to reduce manual intervention and improve process TATs.
* Maintain a central repository of automated workflows and regularly update stakeholders on enhancements.


**Governance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure regular system audits and hygiene checks for all HR platforms.
* Track vendor performance, maintain SLAs, and report deviations proactively.
* Benchmark internal practices against industry standards and recommend technology upgrades.
* Keep abreast of new tools, innovations, and practices in digital HR and analytics.


**Key skills \& Competencies:**
* Technical Acumen: Strong grasp of HRIS/HRMS platforms, module configurations, and system workflows.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to extract, analyze, and interpret data to support strategic HR decisions.
* Project Management: Ability to manage system rollouts, testing, timelines, and multi\-stakeholder coordination.
* Process Orientation: Experience in automating manual HR processes for efficiency and accuracy.
* Problem Solving: Ability to resolve technical issues, coordinate with vendors, and manage post\-deployment issues.
* Communication Skills: Clear and structured communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Required Education and Experience:**
* Masters in Business Administration (HR Specialization).
* B. Tech/ MCA/ BCA with HRMS implementation including \- work flow configuration experience can also apply.
* 3\-6 Years of experience in managing / operating HRMS implementation including backend configuration and complete understanding of system workflows.
* Sharp data analysis skills and workflow understanding is a must for this role.

**Your key responsibilities:**
 The Associate Director Resource Management will play a pivotal role in leading workforce optimization initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, executing strategic initiatives centrally as an SME and driving transformation within the Workforce Management / Resource Management Function at GDS. The incumbent will be instrumental in streamlining the people and process agenda, ensuring alignment with organisational goals. The role encompasses leading the function's branding and communications strategy and also ensures the effective integration and delivery of cross\-functional initiatives. The role demands a strategic thinker with a proven track record in leadership, change management, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Some of your key responsibilities include:**
* Lead and manage the Resource Management Team of a competency or competencies, providing guidance, mentorship, and support to team members.
* Become strategic partner to enable the competency to achieve their objectives by providing key insights with respect to people and performance.
* Develop and implement resource management strategies aligned with organizational objectives, ensuring efficient allocation and utilization of resources across projects.
* Lead the workforce planning, bench management and capacity planning exercises for the competency or competencies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders both offshore and onshore to understand project requirements, resource demands, and constraints, ensuring appropriate staffing and skill alignment.
* Driving resource planning initiatives, including analyzing resource availability, forecasting future needs, and identifying potential risks or bottlenecks.
* Monitoring, analyzing resource utilization and allocation, optimizing it across projects and driving improvement initiatives.
* Oversee resource conflict resolution, working closely with project managers and stakeholders to find suitable resolutions and ensure project success.
* Collaborate with the function head to develop and implement workforce strategies that align with the organisation’s overall business objectives.
* Lead the execution of strategic initiatives, ensuring they are delivered on time, as per scope and plan.
* Drive function transformation projects, optimizing processes and people charter to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Influence function leads within and outside the immediate function, at times without formal authority and basis relationships to drive consensus towards common objectives and goals.
* Work closely with the function head to monitor and track critical impact initiatives.
* Support function leader with benchmarking efforts, market insights \& best practices to stay competitive.

 As a Scrum Master within the Enterprise IT Legal, Compliance \& Security Value Team, you will support the Compliance Product Line, delivering technology solutions for the Ethics \& Compliance Office (ECO). * Remove impediments and blockers that hinder the delivery team's progress, escalating to the Delivery Manager, Product Manager, or other senior leaders when issues require broader organizational intervention.

* Promote continuous improvement by facilitating meaningful retrospectives, tracking action items to completion, and coaching the team on Agile best practices and Scrum principles.

* Support the delivery team's collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders, including Solution Architects, Business Analysts, Delivery Managers, Product Managers, and application integration teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment.

* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and collaborating with the Product Manager. Participate in product planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with both functional and product goals.

**Primary skill\- Scrum Master,Agile framework
   

  

 Secondary Skill\-SDLC**
 Must Have

description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
   

  

 Senior Technical Writer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru \& Chennai, India
   

  

**Department:** 
 Technical Communication Center of Excellence
   

  

**Company:** 
 Xylem Water Solutions India Private Limited, Global Capability Center, Bangalore
   

  

**About Xylem**
 Xylem is a leading global water technology company committed to solving the world’s most challenging water issues through innovation. Our mission is to enable sustainable, efficient water use and management for communities, industries, and the environment.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Senior Technical Writer at Xylem, you will be part of the Global Technical Communication Center of Excellence, responsible for developing world\-class customer documentation (Hardware/Software). You will author and manage content within a Component Content Management System (CCMS), collaborating closely with Project Coordinators and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) globally. Your work will support customers of Xylem products and systems through clear, accurate, and user\-focused documentation such as Installation and Operation Instructions, Service Manuals, and other technical publications.
   

  

 As you grow in this role, you will have opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement projects, process optimization, and training initiatives within Xylem’s documentation ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Technical Communication Center Of Excellence**
 A global team of technical information specialists responsible for developing customer product information across Xylem’s product portfolio. The team focuses on intelligent content reuse using XML\-based technologies, ensuring all publications are customer\-centric, reusable, and globally consistent across multiple outputs, channels, and languages.
   

  

 Prominent collaterals include Installation and Operation Instructions, Datasheets, Quick Guides, UI Guides, and UX Guides, Technical specifications etc.
   

  

 The team consists of a Content Development (Production) Team, a Localization Team, and a Documentation Systems Team.
   

  

**About The Team In Bengaluru \& Chennai (GCC)**
 The Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru \& Chennai serves as a shared service; resources supporting Xylem’s global product portfolio — including pumps, turbines, monitoring and control systems, and water analysis equipment. The team contributes to product design, development, testing, and technical documentation to deliver innovative and reliable water technology solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Content Development
   

  

* Develop reusable, structured technical content aligned with Xylem’s authoring guidelines, information model, and style guide.
* Conduct task analysis (TA) and prepare annotated topic lists (ATL).
* Create and maintain Topics, Chaptermaps, Bookmaps, and metadata within the CCMS.
* Produce and maintain illustrations, graphics, and photo\-realistic renderings.
* Ensure the completion of review cycle and software\-assisted checks for grammar, style, and terminology.
* Initiate translation requests and coordinate translation reviews.
* Communicate release updates to stakeholders via designated channels.
* Contribute to the development of the CCMS structure, templates, and information model.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and content governance.


**Required Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Aeronautical, Computer Science, or equivalent field).


**Experience**
* 4–6 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer (Senior level) in an international, English\-language environment.
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Basic experience creating technical illustrations in vector or raster formats.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

 Core Skills
   

  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Detail\-oriented, structured, and dependable on meeting deadlines.
* Effective communicator with global, cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE) and style guides such as the Microsoft or Chicago Manual of Style.
* Understanding of DDLC, SDLC, and Agile workflows.
* Knowledge of single sourcing, metadata management, and conditional profiling.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in DITA XML and CCMS platforms such as Astoria On\-Demand or AEM.
* Skilled in XML editors such as Oxygen XML Editor or Arbortext Editor.
* Experience with terminology and content quality tools such as Acrolinx.
* Proficiency with illustration tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Creo Illustrate, Keyshot).
* Experience with collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Understanding of content publishing pipelines and localization workflows.
* Working knowledge of XML\-based formats and related technologies (XQuery, metadata tagging).
* Interest in GenAI and automation using Python or similar programming languages is desirable.


 Assessment Process
   

  

* Candidates will complete a writing and structuring test to demonstrate technical English and content organization skills.
* Successful candidates will advance to subsequent interview rounds with technical and hiring teams


 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Technical Content Writer (2 to 4 Years Experience)(Immediate Joiner) (Ahmedabad)
description:
**Company Description** 




 MediaF5™ is a results\-driven digital marketing agency that partners with startups, SMEs, and growing brands to build structured marketing systems that deliver measurable growth. The team focuses on generating quality leads, increasing brand visibility, and designing campaigns that convert. Core services include SEO, social media marketing, website design and development, performance marketing, content and creative strategy, and video production. MediaF5™ emphasizes clear strategy, data\-backed decisions, transparent reporting, and a strong understanding of the local market in Ahmedabad. The agency offers an environment where performance and creativity go hand in hand, helping brands scale sustainably.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site Technical Content Writer role based in Ahmedabad, ideal for professionals with 2 to 4 years of experience who can join immediately. The Technical Content Writer will create clear, engaging, and technically accurate content for websites, blogs, landing pages, product/service pages, case studies, and marketing collateral. Responsibilities include translating complex technical concepts into accessible language, researching industry trends and client offerings, and optimizing content for SEO and digital campaigns. The role involves collaborating with SEO specialists, designers, developers, and marketing teams to align content with campaign goals and brand guidelines. The writer will also review and refine existing content, ensure consistency in tone and terminology, and contribute ideas to the overall content and creative strategy.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong Web Content Writing and Writing skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience in Content Strategy and Research, including structuring content for user intent, SEO, and campaign objectives.
* Proficiency in proofreading with attention to grammar, clarity, and brand voice consistency.
* 2 to 4 years of professional experience as a Technical Content Writer or similar role in a digital marketing or technology\-focused environment.
* Familiarity with SEO best practices, keyword research, and on\-page optimization for content.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and manage multiple projects with tight deadlines.
* Comfort working on\-site in Ahmedabad and availability to join immediately.
* Bachelor’s degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience writing for B2B, SaaS, or IT/technology domains is a strong advantage.

**Additional Information**

title: Technical Writer
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 26 Jun 2026
   

  

 At Medtronic you can begin a life\-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You’ll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
 Our Cardiovascular Portfolio operating units offer devices and therapies that treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms and heart failure, peripheral, coronary, and aortic arterial diseases, and host of other cardiac and blood flow\-related ailments. Together, we will transform the lives of people who suffer from these diseases.
   

  

 At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In\-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross\-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.
   

  

 This position will be based in Mounds View, MN.
   

  

 In this exciting role as a
 **Technical Writer** 
 , you will produce customer\-facing product documentation, including but not limited to user guides and instructions for use (IFUs). This includes labeling for both clinicians and patients that accompany medical device products that conform to the Medtronic documentation and quality assurance standards. Projects include R\&D new product development as well as sustaining activities/legacy document maintenance for various products produced by the Cardiovascular portfolio. You will identify document requirements, collect inputs from cross\-functional technical staff and distill this technical information into detailed, accurate content for manuals and/or web\-based documents for technical and non\-technical users.
   

  

 Responsible for supporting documentation to the customer\-facing content which may include labeling design plans, trace documents, technical reviews, and verification deliverables. You will support product documentation updates to comply with EU MDR, FDA, EN 60601, and other regulatory body requirements by incorporating customer inputs and ensuring standardization of document development to comply with Medtronic design standards.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
 Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
   

  

* Plan, research, develop, and write medical device labeling, and manage labeling deliverables as part of cross\-functional project teams under general supervision.
* Write clear, simple content that speaks to customers in their own language. Understand the impact of localization on English content and writing for a global audience.
* Effectively communicate the appropriate level of detail based on technical and customer requirements.
* Collaborate openly and effectively with a range of stakeholders, including writers and subject matter experts.
* Coordinate IFU release in the Product Lifecycle Management System (MAP Agile).
* Understand how regulations, laws, and standards influence content design.
* Understand and adhere to all quality management system documents and product commercialization procedures applicable to labeling development.
* Manage multiple projects and communicate status proactively. Successfully negotiate project schedules, plans, and milestones.
* Contribute to time and cost estimates for labeling deliverables for project teams.
* Take direction to be able to work independently and make sound decisions. Express ideas clearly and diplomatically.
* Develop documentation for regulatory submissions and maintain design documentation to support quality and regulatory process requirements.
* Assist in providing documentation for CAPAs, and departmental and business\-unit audits.
* Participate in department and business\-unit initiatives.
* Oversee change order process for labeling.
* Coordinate translations and track the status of translations.
* Additional tasks as assigned.


**Must Have (Minimum Requirements):**
*To be considered for this role, the minimum requirements must be evident on your resume.*
* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum of 2 years of communications, labeling, and/or technical writing experience
* Advanced degree with 0 years of communications, labeling, and/or technical writing experience


**Nice to Have (Preferred Qualifications):**
* 2\+ years of experience as a technical/medical writer in the medical device, scientific, or other regulated industry
* Understand industry trends in technical communication, information architecture, and content development
* Experience creating content for software or apps and managing software documentation projects
* Experience using product lifecycle management (PLM) software
* Exceptional writing and communication skills
* Experience working with cross\-functional project teams
* Experience authoring in XML within a content management system
* Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities
* Ability to work effectively across disciplines to implement creative solutions to complex problems
* Knowledge of Medtronic products and quality systems
* Knowledge of formal reviews and system validation processes. Knowledge of software technologies used for writing, publishing, and document control
* Knowledge of structured writing and minimalism
* Aptitude to learn new requirements, processes, and tools
* Excellent problem\-solving skills
* Self\-directed and highly organized
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy


 For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R.
   

  

* 214\.2(h)(4\)(iii)(A) is required.

* Redux patterns and a strong willingness to learn and grow

**Good to have:**
* Knowledge of clean architecture/layered architecture

 Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
   

  

 Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

title: Freelance Frontend Developer (Landing Pages & Websites)
description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled F
 **rontend Developers (HTML/CSS/JavaScript, React/Next.js)** 
 to join the Tendem project (https://tendem.ai/) and build high\-quality landing pages and multi\-page websites within our hybrid AI \+ human environment. In this role, as an AI Pilot \- that's how we refer to this position at Mindrift \- you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide frontend craftsmanship, design sensibility, and quality control to ensure pixel\-perfect, conversion\-ready websites that match real client briefs. This part\-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands\-on experience in landing page production, multi\-page website development, and modern frontend frameworks.
   

  

**What We Do**
 The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real\-world expertise from across the globe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Frontend Developer, you'll design, build, and refine landing pages, waitlist pages, promo pages, and small multi\-page sites (portfolios, restaurant sites, small business sites, simple online stores), turning client briefs into responsive, performant, polished web experiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build landing pages, waitlist pages, and promo pages with clear hero sections, CTAs, and conversion\-focused layouts
* Build small multi\-page websites (Home, About, Services, Contact, etc.) that follow client requirements and basic information architecture
* Implement responsive, mobile\-first layouts that work cleanly across devices and browsers
* Integrate forms, email capture, basic analytics, and simple CMS or headless content sources
* Apply on\-page SEO basics (semantic HTML, meta tags, performance, accessibility) so pages are ready to rank and run ads against
* Evaluate AI\-generated frontend output and refine markup, styling, structure, and copy placement to production quality
* Troubleshoot layout, performance, and cross\-browser issues independently


**Requirements And Benefits**
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in frontend development, landing page production, or website development (required)
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Design, or related fields is a plus
* Candidates should have a strong foundation in modern frontend development, responsive web design, and building high\-quality landing pages and small websites. We are looking for specialists who can create polished, conversion\-focused user experiences, work confidently with modern frontend frameworks, and refine AI\-assisted output into production\-ready interfaces. A strong visual eye, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential
* Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including responsive design, Flexbox, and Grid
* Hands\-on experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Astro, or similar)
* Experience with utility\-first CSS (Tailwind) or modern component libraries
* Ability to translate Figma designs or written briefs into clean, maintainable code
* Familiarity with form handling, email capture services, and basic analytics setup (GA4, Plausible, or similar)
* Working knowledge of on\-page SEO, accessibility (WCAG basics), and Core Web Vitals
* Comfortable working with simple CMSs or headless content (Webflow, Framer, Sanity, Contentful, or similar) is a plus
* Strong attention to detail and visual taste — pages should look intentional, not generic
* Self\-directed work ethic with the ability to deliver complete pages with minimal supervision
* Portfolio of shipped landing pages and/or small websites (required)
* English proficiency: Upper\-intermediate (B2\) or above (required)


**Project time expectations**
 For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10\-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.
   

  

**Compensation**
 On this project, contributors can earn up to
 **$35 per hour equivalent** 
 , depending on their level and pace of contribution.
   

  

 Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
   

  

**Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?**
* Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection
* Gain hands\-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field
* Participate in performance\-based bonus programs that reward high\-quality work and consistent delivery

title: Embedded Firmware Developer
description:
**Job Role: Embedded Firmware Developer** 




**Location:** 
 Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Mumbai
 



**Job Category:** 
 Project Research Staff
 



  





**About the project:** 




 The Government\-funded project focuses on the development and demonstration of drone and allied technologies. With applications spanning various sectors, the initiative leverages advanced technologies and infrastructure. It aims to foster strong industry\-academia collaborations to address real\-world challenges and drive innovation. Comprehensive training programs are an integral component, ensuring awareness and proficiency in drone operations.
 



  





**Institute:** 




 Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay, Mumbai
 



  





**Qualification and Key Skills Required:** 



* PhD in a relevant experience
 **OR**
* MTech / ME or equivalent with minimum 2 years of relevant experience
 **OR**
* BTech / BE or equivalent with minimum 4 years of relevant experience



  





**Candidate must have following skills \& experience\-** 



* Proficient in developing, debugging, and optimizing embedded firmware in C/C\+\+.
* Must have hands\-on experience with ARM Cortex (M4 and above), STM32, RISC\-V microcontroller families.
* Strong experience in Bare\-Metal Firmware Development with deep understanding of hardware concepts like SFR, Interrupts, Timers, PWM, Flash, Memory maps, DMA, Bootloader etc.
* Experience of driver development for SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet etc.
* Must have working experience of multi\-threading and Real\-Time Operating System like Nuttx, ZephyrRTOS, etc.
* Strong understanding of Systems Architecture
* Skilled in using tools like JTAG/SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers for troubleshooting firmware/hardware issues.
* Strong understanding of with version control systems (e.g, git\-based workflows) and development pipelines.
* Good understanding of coding practises, modularity, unit testing in embedded systems.
* Experience with CMake and Makefile compiler toolchain



  





**Preferred to have \-** 



* Familiarity with control systems, sensor fusion, UAV/autopilot systems and flight controller firmware (Ardupilot, Betaflight) is an added advantage.
* Experience with safety/certification standards (e.g., ISO 26262, DO\-178C)
* Experience with drones, avionics, robotics, or autonomous system
* Proficiency in Python for tooling, testing or scripting








**Job Profile:** 



* Design, develop, and maintain robust, efficient embedded firmware for autopilot and UAV\-based applications.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
NVIDIA is seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst with deep expertise in incident response, forensics investigation, threat hunting, and proactive cyber defense. This role is ideal for a cybersecurity professional passionate about defending enterprise and product environments against advanced threats, and eager to tackle complex investigations across diverse platforms. As part of our Cyber Defense \& Response team, you will lead efforts to detect, analyze, and respond to sophisticated attacks targeting NVIDIA’s corporate, cloud, and product ecosystems. You will leverage your technical skills to drive investigations, orchestrate automated responses, and strengthen our security posture across infrastructure and products.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to make a significant impact in the industry, collaborating with elite experts in security, data science, and AI to shape the future of product security technologies. If this sounds like a fun challenge and you are a hands\-on Security Analyst, we want to hear from you!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead Incident Response efforts for corporate, cloud, and product environments, including investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery.
* Perform threat hunting across endpoints, networks, and cloud workloads to proactively identify indicators of compromise, emerging threats, and control gaps.
* Conduct cloud incident response for AWS, Azure, and GCP, and other cloud environments including Kubernetes and containerized workloads, performing log analysis, identity compromise investigations, and workload forensics.
* Drive product security incident response, collaborating with engineering teams to analyze potential exposure to vulnerabilities, exploits, and security flaws in NVIDIA products.
* Perform digital forensics and malware analysis to support investigations and root cause analysis.
* Develop and optimize security orchestration and automation playbooks in partnership with Security Engineering to accelerate detection and response.
* Build and refine detections and defense strategies based on threat models and attacker behaviors across cloud, identity, endpoint, and product telemetry, using frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK to map adversary tactics and enhance detection coverage.
* Provide guidance to engineering and business teams on secure design and incident handling standards and contribute to security policies, standards, and metrics to continuously improve NVIDIA’s security posture.


**What We Need To See**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in incident response and threat hunting, including cloud environments.
* Strong knowledge of cloud security principles, identity and access management, and workload protection.
* Experience with product security investigations, vulnerability analysis, and secure coding practices.
* Proficiency in forensic analysis, intrusion detection, and threat intelligence.
* Advanced knowledge of network analysis, OS internals (Windows/Linux/macOS), and web application security, including the ability to detect abnormal behaviors and assess exploit paths.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across global teams.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, AWS/Azure Security Specialty, CISSP.
* Experience with cloud\-native security tools (e.g., AWS GuardDuty, Azure Sentinel, GCP Security Command Center).
* Development experience in Python, Go, or similar for building security automation.

title: Lead Network Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 Would you like to help enrich the lives of learners around the world?
   

  

 RM India (RM Education Solutions India Private Limited) is the India Delivery Center for UK based RM Plc. A leading supplier of technology and resources to the education sector, RM India helps deliver great education products and services that help teachers to teach and learners to learn. Our mission is to achieve growth by improving life chances of people. At RM India, we are driven by the potential of our business to touch lives and shape the future.
   

  

 At RM, we’ve been pioneers of education technology since 1973\. We provide technology and resources to the education sector, supporting over 20 million students and improving educational outcomes worldwide.
   

  

 What we do helps learners at all stages of their lives, from preschool to higher education and professional qualification; we partner with schools, examination boards, governments, and professional organisations globally to make learning more accessible, more engaging, and more impactful.
   

  

 RM operates through three divisions: Assessment (digital assessment and marking solutions), Technology (managed services, hardware, and software for schools), and TTS (educational resources).
   

  

 Visit us here to find out more: www.rm.com
   

  

**We encourage early applications as the vacancy may close once the position has been filled or final interviews have been arranged.**
**Responsibilities**
 RM Broadband develops, delivers and supports RM‘s Internet services product portfolio, primarily focussed on the schools and education sector. RM Broadband have been providing Internet services since 1995 and currently supplies them to over 3000 sites and 1\.5 million users.
   

  

 Services include leased line, FTTP, FTTC or 4G/5G Internet connectivity; RM SafetyNet web filtering; managed firewalls; remote access VPNs and managed WAN services.
   

  

 The job holder will work within the Broadband Infrastructure development team, and will be responsible for the architecture, technical development and 4th line operational support of various ISP\-based products and services. Additionally, you will provide pre\-sales support for more complex technical implementations to our sales teams.
   

  

 Working across both networking and server disciplines, this varied role will require deep understanding of many technologies, for example: Juniper service provider networking, FortiGate firewalling, virtualisation, Linux servers and Python scripting for automation.
   

  

 The job holder will work at all stages of the development life cycle, from conception or initial user requirements through design, development, testing, operational and delivery handover and product maintenance.
   

  

* Provide technical support for the development, implementation and maintenance of our network, server infrastructure and associated ISP services in a project\-oriented environment.
* Act as a subject matter expert for our network infrastructure.
* Maintain physical and logical design documentation to ensure consistency and compliance with all relevant industry standards.
* Assist with the ongoing support and operational function of the ISP network and associated services, providing a 4th line support role for escalated support requests from our operations teams.
* The job holder will be tasked with identifying and implementing improvements to the RM Broadband estate to improve service to our customers, increase operational and delivery efficiency, reduce costs and help grow the RM Broadband business.
* You will act as mentor and coach to more junior members of the team and facilitate a close working relationship across the UK and India development and operations teams. You will provide technical training, share and embed best practice and processes and ensure these are adhered to.


**Experience**
 Exp:\-10\+yrs
   

  

* Significant experience developing and operating ISP or large enterprise related infrastructure.
* Skilled in leading network projects and providing senior\-level technical support.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; able to simplify complexity and deliver practical solutions.
* Be a strategic thinker who can communicate network concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Expertise in service provider technologies, including MPLS, BGP, OSPF, IPv4 and IPv6, inter\-provider connectivity.
* Knowledge of Juniper networking, in particular the MX series routers, SRX firewalls and EX/QFX switches.
* Experience with next generation firewalls, in particular the Fortinet firewall stack and their deployment in SD\-WAN configurations.
* Technical knowledge and operational experience of Linux environments (RedHat and Ubuntu), LVS load balancing, web proxies, SMTP and e\-mail filtering, DNS.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, ELK or equivalents).


**The Following Qualifications Are Desirable**
* JNCIP\-SP or CCNP Service Provider or equivalent
* NSE4 or higher Fortinet certification
* RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer)


 What's in it for you?
   

  

 At RM My Work Blend @RM provides office\-based colleagues with multi location and hybrid working options to suit them. As well as your office base, you can spend a proportion of your time working at alternative locations, and with flexibility of hours, as appropriate to the role. We encourage you to discuss arrangements for this role with your potential line manager during the recruitment process. We expect how we make best use of hybrid working may continue to adapt as we adjust to our new ways of working.
   

  

 As well as a competitive salary our core benefits package includes Group Health Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life Insurance, Doctor consultation reimbursement, annually, Medical reimbursement, monthly/Qtry/Annual Rewards \& Recognition program, Annual Salary Review \& Bonus payouts, Children’s Education Assistance Subsidy, Summer Vacation Scheme, Staff Children Engagement Programme, Knowledge Acquisition Subsidy, Transportation Subsidy, Birthday \& Marriage gifts and Subsidized Technopark Club Membership. RM India also has a comprehensive Rewards \& recognition program to recognize and reward employees. You could even earn yourself an extra bonus for successfully recommending a friend or family member for a position within RM.
   

  

 To better reflect the society that we serve, we’re committed to building a diverse workforce and creating an inclusive and welcoming environments for all. To achieve this, we create teams of talented people from different backgrounds and experiences and strive to be a business where our people can bring their whole selves to work, we also want to make the recruitment process as inclusive as possible for everyone. Should you require additional support with your application or through the interview process, please contact us at recruitment@rm.com

title: Product Manager
description:
**Overview**
 CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. For this critical role, we are looking for the candidate to be based in Mumbai. You may choose to work from home in Mumbai; however, you will be required to travel to our Andheri East office at least twice a week for business requirements, meetings, or company/team events, or on short notice as needed.
   

  

 You will join a cross\-functional product and growth team responsible for improving activation, engagement, monetization, and retention across Editage’s offerings. We value ownership, outcomes, and autonomy. You will be empowered to take end\-to\-end responsibility for your product area while collaborating closely with engineering, marketing, design, and leadership teams.
   

  

 Editage, the flagship brand of CACTUS, is a global leader in researcher solutions and science communication. We support millions of researchers worldwide through expert services and AI\-powered products that improve how research is written, published, and discovered. We are looking for a Product Manager to drive growth and innovation across Editage’s digital platforms and AI\-driven solutions. This role will play a key part in shaping how researchers interact with our products, ensuring we deliver meaningful value at every stage of the research journey.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and drive the product growth roadmap for Editage.
* Define and execute product strategies through a mix of big bets and incremental improvements.
* Analyze user behavior and data to uncover insights on engagement, conversion, retention, and churn.
* Design, run, and evaluate experimentation programs to optimize funnel metrics.
* Partner closely with Growth Marketing to unlock opportunities across in\-app and lifecycle journeys.
* Collaborate with product squads to drive feature adoption and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Track competitors and stay up to date on AI and EdTech trends.


**Qualifications And Prerequisites**
* 2\+ years of product management experience driving B2C growth metrics.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable working in fast\-paced, evolving environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Agile, JIRA, analytics, and wireframing tools.
* Strong understanding of generative AI and workflow automation.
* Growth mindset with a passion for experimentation and learning.


 Application Process
   

  

 Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, there will be 3 rounds of interviews and all interviews will be done virtually using MS Teams.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
   

  

**Accelerating from Anywhere**
 As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.
   

  

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


**About CACTUS**
 Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

 We want to hire ambitious, and value\-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross\-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high\-growth environment with a fast\-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems.
   

  

**About Us**
 At Modulr, our vision is a world where all businesses are powered by embedded payments. Modulr enables businesses, from SMEs to Enterprise, initially across the UK and Europe to efficiently pay\-in, collect and disburse funds instantly via a range of payment schemes, accounts, and card products.
   

  

 We have created an industry\-leading API platform with comprehensive online tools and access, to meet the demands of daily business payments. We have two routes to market. Our Core Business Payments product allows customers in any sector to connect to us and our expanding network of accounting and payroll platforms, including Sage, Xero, BrightPay and IRIS to automate payments. Our Vertical Solutions targets a growing range of industry verticals which directly connect their IT platforms to our APIs and webhooks. We solve complex payment problems for hundreds of clients in a range of industries, including Travel, Lending, Wage Advance, and Investment \& Wealth.
   

  

 We are deeply integrated into the payment eco\-system. In the UK, we are direct participants of Faster Payments and Bacs. Modulr hold settlement accounts at the Bank of England. Our payment network connectivity includes CHAPS, Open Banking, SEPA, SWIFT and account issuance in multiple currencies. We are principal issuing members of Visa and Mastercard schemes across UK and Europe.
   

  

 Our regulatory permissions and governance structure are the foundations of our business. We are regulated and supervised as an Authorised Electronic Money Institution (AEMI) in the UK by the Financial Conduct Authority and in the Netherlands by De Nederlandsche Bank.
   

  

 Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by the venture arms of payments giants PayPal and FIS, as well as growth investors Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog Capital and Highland Europe.
   

  

 Modulr now has over 400 employees spread globally across offices in London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**Modulr values**
* Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
* Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
* Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.


**The Team**
 At Modulr we are focused on building autonomous squads that are focused on working in
   

  

 the best possible way. We operate in a tribes and squad model with each area focused on
   

  

 a particular growth area. Each squad is small and cross\-functional. We have big ambitions and have many interesting challenges ahead.
   

  

**Summary**
 In this role you will design, build, and evolve the next generation of Modulr’s event\-driven payments platform. You’ll work across the full engineering lifecycle—from shaping technical approaches to delivering production\-grade software—within a squad that values ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Specific duties
   

  

**Engineering \& Architecture**
* Design and develop backend services using Java (17\+) or similar OO languages.
* Build and evolve microservices and distributed, event\-driven components in a cloud\-native environment.
* Contribute to architectural patterns that support throughput, resilience, reliability, and observability.
* Design clean, well\-documented RESTful APIs and service contracts.
* Work with relational data stores, especially PostgreSQL, and contribute to data modelling.


 Distributed Systems \& Reliability
   

  

* Engineer solutions for concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, retries, and high availability.
* Improve system performance, reduce latency, and identify bottlenecks across services.
* Build systems with strong observability—logs, metrics, tracing—ensuring issues can be diagnosed quickly.


**Quality \& Testing**
* Develop comprehensive automated tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber.
* Participate in design and code reviews, helping raise engineering standards across the team.
* Advocate for code quality, maintainability, and long\-term technical health.


 DevOps, Cloud \& Tooling
   

  

* Use and improve deployment pipelines and operational tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS services).
* Contribute to internal frameworks, shared libraries, and engineering best practices.
* Help shape the evolution of our platform toward a more flexible, modern architecture.


 Collaboration \& Delivery
   

  

* Work in an agile environment, contributing to planning, design discussions, and iterative delivery.
* Collaborate across squads to shape technical solutions that span multiple systems.
* Document best practices, reference architectures, and design approaches others can rely on.


**About You**
 You’re an engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and enjoys solving complex, system\-level problems. You bring:
   

  

* 4\+ years expertise in Java or another OO language with willingness to work in Java.
* Strong understanding of OOP, design patterns, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience building and operating microservices in production.
* Ability to reason about concurrency, performance, and system behaviour under load.
* Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative, team\-first mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills supported by sound engineering judgement.
* Ability to manage complexity, balance competing priorities, and deliver high\-quality work.
* A growth mindset—you enjoy learning, improving, and helping others grow.
* A self\-starter attitude with a passion for ownership and continuous improvement.


**ModInclusion**
 At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it’s also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

title: Freelance Full-Stack Web App Developer
description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled
 **Full\-Stack Web App Developers (JavaScript/TypeScript \+ Python or Node)** 
 to join the Tendem project (https://tendem.ai/) and build interactive browser\-based applications within our hybrid AI \+ human environment. In this role, as an AI Pilot \- that's how we refer to this position at Mindrift \- you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide full\-stack engineering expertise, architectural judgment, and quality control to ensure web apps are functional, robust, and ready for real users. This part\-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands\-on experience in modern frontend frameworks, backend APIs, databases, and shipping interactive web products end\-to\-end.
   

  

**What We Do**
 The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real\-world expertise from across the globe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Full\-Stack Web App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine browser\-based applications with real logic, state, persistence, and user input — from habit trackers and budgeting tools to internal dashboards, mini\-SaaS tools, and AI\-powered apps. You may also work on standalone Python applications and data\-processing scripts that sit alongside or behind these products.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build interactive web applications with frontend (React, Next.js, Vue, or similar) and a backend API (Python/FastAPI/Flask or Node/Express)
* Design and implement data models, schemas, and persistence layers using SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite) or NoSQL stores
* Implement authentication, sessions, and basic role\-based access where needed
* Integrate third\-party APIs and AI/LLM services (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into product features
* Handle state management, user input validation, error states, and loading states cleanly
* Build standalone Python tools and scripts where required by the task (data processing, API clients, lightweight backend utilities)
* Evaluate AI\-generated full\-stack code and refactor it for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability
* Write clear, testable code and debug end\-to\-end issues across frontend, backend, and database


**Requirements And Benefits**
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in full\-stack web development or shipping interactive web applications (required)
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus
* Candidates should have a strong foundation in full\-stack web development, modern frontend frameworks, backend architecture, and building interactive browser\-based applications end\-to\-end. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work across frontend, backend, databases, and APIs, design robust application logic, and refine AI\-assisted output into production\-ready products. Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently architect and ship complete features are essential
* Strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar)
* Solid backend experience in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/or Node.js (Express, NestJS)
* Hands\-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and basic schema design
* Experience implementing REST APIs, request validation, error handling, and authentication flows
* Familiarity with deployment platforms (Vercel, Netlify, Render, Fly.io, Railway, or similar)
* Experience integrating LLM APIs or other AI services into product features is a strong plus
* Comfortable with version control (Git) and basic testing practices
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to building working, robust products — not demos
* Self\-directed work ethic with the ability to architect, build, and ship features independently
* Portfolio of shipped web applications (required)
* English proficiency: Upper\-intermediate (B2\) or above (required)


**Project time expectations**
 For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10\-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.
   

  

**Compensation**
 On this project, contributors can earn up to
 **$35 per hour equivalent** 
 , depending on their level and pace of contribution.
   

  

 Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
   

  

**Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?**
* Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection. \-
* Gain hands\-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field
* Participate in performance\-based bonus programs that reward high\-quality work and consistent delivery

title: Unreal Animation Artist (Junior)
description:
**Location:** 

 Remote
 




**Salary:** 
 ₹2\.4 LPA
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





 As a Junior Animation Artist, you will
 **directly contribute to game animation** 
 from day one, hitting the ground running on real production assets. We are looking for a focused, capable animator who can jump straight into creating and polishing dynamic character movements, combat sequences, and creature animations. This is not a training program; your work will actively shape how our gameplay feels, looks, and responds.
 



  




 About the Studio
 
 We are an independent game studio developing a Souls\-like action RPG using Unreal Engine 5\. Our focus is on gameplay depth, combat systems, and atmospheric worlds. This role is designed for candidates who want real production experience and are ready to deliver, not just look for training assignments.
 



  




 Role Overview
 
 Working closely with senior developers and artists, you will bring our characters and enemies to life. This role is ideal for an ambitious animator who wants to build a powerhouse game industry portfolio, prove their capabilities in a live pipeline, and transition into a long\-term full\-time career with us.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * **Execute Core Animation:** 
 Animate player characters and enemies, focusing on high\-impact combat mechanics (attacks, combos, dodges, and hit reactions).
* **Cleanup \& Polish:** 
 Clean up, iterate, and polish keyframe animations to fit the rigorous pacing and weight requirements of a Souls\-like game.
* **Engine Integration:** 
 Import, retarget, and test animations directly within Unreal Engine 5 to ensure they function flawlessly in\-game.
* **Cross\-Discipline Collaboration:** 
 Partner with gameplay programmers and designers to align animation frames perfectly with combat hitboxes and frame data.
* **Debug Art Assets:** 
 Identify and resolve animation\-related bugs, clipping issues, and blending errors in the engine.



  




 Required Skills
 * **Strong Animation Fundamentals:** 
 A proven grasp of weight, timing, execution, and body mechanics (especially for melee combat).
* **Software Proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard 3D animation software (Blender, Maya, or 3ds Max).
* **Unreal Engine Basics:** 
 Basic familiarity with Unreal Engine's animation pipeline (importing FBXs, understanding skeletons, and previewing assets).
* **Action\-Centric Eye:** 
 Ability to analyze and replicate realistic or highly stylized physical weight and impact.
* **Portfolio/Showreel:** 
 A mandatory portfolio link showing character locomotion, combat, or creature animations.



  




 Good to Have (Optional)
 * Exposure to Unreal Engine 5 Animation Blueprints, State Machines, or Montages.
* Experience cleaning up and editing motion capture data.
* Previous participation in game jams or indie projects.



  




 What We Offer
 * **Monthly Stipend:** 
 ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 (Based on portfolio and technical screening).
* **Mentorship:** 
 Direct feedback and guidance from experienced developers.
* **Shipped Credit:** 
 Official credit in the shipped game title.
* **Documentation:** 
 Certificate of completion / Experience letter.
* **Full\-Time Conversion:** 
 Opportunity to convert to a permanent full\-time role based on production performance.
* **Industry Portfolio:** 
 High\-quality, real\-world portfolio material for future game industry roles.



  




 What You Will Learn
 * Production\-quality game animation pipelines for high\-end action RPGs.
* Real\-world implementation of animation tech inside Unreal Engine 5\.
* Deep understanding of how animators, designers, and gameplay programmers collaborate to build satisfying combat loops.
* Practical debugging and optimization standards used in professional game studios.

description:
Job Description – Senior HR Executive (Payroll, Statutory Compliance \& HR Operations)

**Position:** Senior HR Executive  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Reports To:** HR Manager / Management

Job Summary

The Senior HR Executive will be responsible for managing payroll administration, statutory compliance, employee records, and day\-to\-day HR operations. The role requires ensuring timely payroll processing, adherence to labor laws and statutory regulations, maintenance of HR documentation, and effective support of overall HR functions to ensure smooth organizational operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Process monthly payroll accurately and within stipulated timelines, including salary calculations, overtime, incentives, deductions, and final settlements.
* Manage and ensure compliance with all applicable statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Gratuity, Bonus, and other labor law obligations.
* Coordinate statutory registrations, filings, inspections, audits, and maintain compliance records and documentation.
* Prepare and submit monthly, quarterly, and annual statutory returns as required by regulatory authorities.
* Maintain employee attendance, leave records, timesheets, and payroll\-related data.
* Handle employee onboarding, documentation, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and separation processes.
* Prepare employment contracts, appointment letters, experience letters, and other HR\-related documents.
* Maintain employee personal files and HR records, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality.
* Support HR audits and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Generate HR MIS reports related to manpower, payroll, attendance, attrition, and statutory compliance for management review.
* Address employee queries related to payroll, benefits, leave, and HR policies.
* Coordinate with Finance and Accounts departments for payroll reconciliation and statutory payments.
* Assist in implementing HR policies, procedures, and process improvements.
* Support recruitment, employee engagement activities, and other HR operational requirements as needed.

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in Payroll, Statutory Compliance, and HR Operations.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws, payroll processes, PF, ESI, PT, Gratuity, Bonus, and other statutory requirements.
* Experience in handling HRMS and payroll software.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and HR reporting.

Key Competencies

* Payroll Administration
* Statutory Compliance Management
* HR Operations \& Documentation
* Labor Law Knowledge
* HRMIS \& Reporting
* Attention to Detail
* Problem\-Solving \& Analytical Skills
* Confidentiality \& Integrity
* Communication \& Coordination Skills

This role is critical in ensuring accurate payroll processing, statutory compliance, and efficient HR operations while supporting the organization's workforce management objectives.

Pay: Up to ₹30,000\.00 per month

description:
**Taxation Manger \- Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Indirect Taxation (GST \& Works Contract)**

**Construction \& Contracting**

* Manage GST compliance including GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, GSTR\-9, and annual reconciliations.
* Oversee GST applicability under Works Contract provisions.
* Ensure accurate ITC reconciliation with GSTR\-2A/2B.
* Monitor RCM applicability on subcontractor and unregistered vendor payments.
* Ensure compliance for interstate stock transfers and SEZ transactions.
* Advise project teams on tax implications during tendering and contract structuring.

**Entertainment Industry**

* Oversee GST compliance for\-Ticket sales \& event revenues, Revenue\-sharing arrangements
* Ensure correct place\-of\-supply treatment for multi\-state events.
* Monitor GST treatment of digital and streaming revenues (if applicable).

**2\. Direct Taxation \& Withholding Compliance**

* Ensure correct deduction and remittance of TDS on:
* Contractor \& subcontractor payments
* Professional \& consultancy fees
* Rent \& commission
* Artist/celebrity payments
* File quarterly TDS returns (24Q, 26Q, 27Q).
* Manage advance tax calculations and corporate tax planning.
* Coordinate Income Tax return filings and tax audits.
* Handle notices, scrutiny assessments, and departmental queries.

**3\. Consolidated Financial Oversight**

**Consolidated Financial Statements**

* Oversee preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidated financial statements for all group entities.
* Ensure elimination of inter\-company transactions during consolidation.
* Support CFO in preparing board\-level financial reports.

**Inter\-company Reconciliation**

* Ensure all cross\-entity transactions are reconciled monthly.
* Prevent elimination errors and mismatches in group financials.
* Maintain detailed documentation for related\-party transactions.

**4\. Audit Management**

* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, and tax auditors.
* Ensure smooth completion of Group Audit processes.
* Facilitate timely finalization of books and audit schedules.
* Address audit observations and implement corrective controls.
* Support management during due diligence exercises.

**5\. Budgetary Control \& Financial Monitoring**

* Monitor “Budget vs. Actual” performance across business units.
* Analyze cost variances in projects, events, and retail operations.
* Alert CFO of significant financial deviations.
* Provide tax impact analysis on budget variances.
* Support financial forecasting and tax provisioning.

**6\. Receivables \& Payables Oversight**

* Supervise AR/AP teams to maintain healthy working capital.
* Review aging reports for:
* Project\-based receivables
* Retail \& event\-based customers
* Ensure timely vendor payments while optimizing cash flow.
* Monitor doubtful debts and provisioning requirements.
* Oversee compliance in vendor tax documentation (GST, PAN, etc.).

**7\. Labour \& Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely remittance and filing of:
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESI)
* Professional Tax (Tamil Nadu norms)
* Ensure compliance with labour\-related tax obligations for site workers.
* Coordinate with HR and payroll teams for statutory accuracy.

**8\. Risk Management \& Compliance Controls**

* Develop and maintain a tax compliance calendar.
* Conduct periodic internal tax reviews and risk assessments.
* Implement internal financial controls across group entities.
* Keep management updated on amendments in GST, Income Tax, and state regulations impacting construction and entertainment sectors.

**Qualifications**

* CA (Mandatory Preferred)
* CMA / CA Inter (with strong taxation exposure) may be considered
* Additional GST certification preferred

**Experience**

* 10–15 years of experience in taxation \& finance
* Strong exposure to Construction / EPC / Works Contract taxation
* Experience in entertainment/event management taxation (preferred)
* Experience in handling multi\-entity group consolidation
